title: Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
Four models in production today. Fifteen to twenty by mid-2027. The shared pipeline that gets them there has to hold — and you own everything after handoff: packaging, deployment, drift detection, and the call on whether a model is fit to serve.

Location: Central Berlin — you work from our office, hybrid with 3 days office and 2 days home office.

 

About us

CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform — and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer — as the operating system for an entire industry.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

 

The platform you build in

Our machine learning runs on one shared, central platform — not a separate pipeline per model. Five canonical stages: data extraction, validation, transformation, training and evaluation. A Snowflake data warehouse feeds a SageMaker managed feature store, and models reach production through governed CI/CD promotion lanes on Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Your job is to build inside it and make it stronger, so the next model costs less to ship than the last one.

 

Your responsibilities

  • You own models from handoff through to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring, and the decision on whether a model is ready to serve
  • You keep production models reliable — drift detection, performance monitoring, alerting and incident response when something moves
  • You own the serving and inference path: fitted pipeline artifacts, inference entry points, monitoring hooks and feature-store parity
  • You review model design and evaluation methodology before anything ships, and catch data leakage, backward-window errors and weak evaluation during development, while they are still cheap to fix
  • You extend the shared platform so it stays useful for every model, without project-specific logic leaking into shared code
  • You set the engineering standards the platform runs on as it scales across the organisation

 

What you bring

  • 4+ years in production machine learning engineering, with real ownership of models after handoff — not only training them
  • Strong Python: typed, tested, production-grade code, and you review the work of others
  • Enough machine learning depth to challenge a pipeline on problem framing, feature engineering, model selection and evaluation methodology
  • Hands-on experience with a managed ML platform — SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks or Azure ML — plus feature stores, CI/CD for machine learning, AWS and Terraform
  • An AI-native way of working: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot actively in your daily work
  • English at C1 level, written and spoken. German is not required — we work in English

Nice to have

  • Snowflake and dbt — you can pick both up here
  • Experience mentoring colleagues or reviewing their work
  • Comfort operating where the answer is not defined yet

What to expect from us

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in office, 2 days remote – plus 25 "Work from Anywhere" days per year
  • 28 days annual leave
  • 2× annual career & development conversations
  • Company pension with 20% employer contribution
  • Fully paid Deutschlandticket (public transport)
  • FitX membership or Urban Sports Club subsidy
  • Virtual stock options — share in the upside
  • Modern IT setup for your day-to-day work
  • Structured onboarding with buddy programme and social events
  • Lived diversity: active women's network, meditation & prayer room

 

Apply now — your CV is enough.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

As an Inside Solutions Engineer, you will collaborate with sales representatives and partners to showcase the value of BeyondTrust’s products, services, and solutions. Acting as a technical specialist within the sales cycle, you will provide foundational support to highlight the capabilities of the BeyondTrust suite. This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop their technical expertise and customer-facing skills in a supportive, team-oriented environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist with marketing campaigns, including webinars and product demonstrations.
  • Support lead qualification by validating technical environments and understanding business problems.
  • Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, ensuring accurate and timely submissions.

  • Articulate the business value of BeyondTrust solutions to prospects and customers.

  • Assist in developing written proposals to complement financial proposals for prospects.

  • 3+ years of experience, including help desk and/or technical support of applications, server infrastructure, desktops, virtualization, and directories.

  • Ability to assess technical requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.

Nice To Have

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (f/m/d)
description:
Purpose of Position

Awin's Legal team advises the group on its legal rights and obligations across a global affiliate and partnership network. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be a trusted, hands-on partner to our commercial, product and leadership teams, leading complex negotiations, supporting M&A and strategic transactions, and helping the business grow across Europe, the UK, the US and beyond. You will report directly to the General Counsel.

We are looking for a pragmatic, business-enabling lawyer who enjoys solving problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is excited about how AI is changing both our industry and the way legal teams work. If you enjoy working across cultures and jurisdictions, join us full-time in one of our hubs, London or Berlin, or work from another country where Awin has an office – you can choose.

Key Tasks

  • Leading the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value commercial agreements with advertisers, publishers, agencies, technology partners and vendors, including MSAs, SaaS and platform terms, partnership agreements, DPAs and NDAs
  • Acting as the go-to legal partner for commercial teams across regions, giving consistent, risk-weighted and business-focused advice that helps close deals
  • Advising on cross-jurisdictional corporate, commercial, competition, intellectual property and regulatory matters under EU, UK, US and other international legal frameworks
  • Supporting M&A and strategic transactions end to end, from due diligence and transaction documents to corporate approvals and post-merger integration
  • Managing disputes, litigation and third-party information requests such as subpoenas, together with external counsel
  • Working with the Privacy team on the commercial and contractual side of data protection, including GDPR, UK GDPR, US state privacy laws and other regimes
  • Shaping how Legal uses AI: introducing AI tools and workflows that make the team more efficient, and advising the business on the legal aspects of AI, including the EU AI Act
  • Improving templates, playbooks and legal processes, and delivering practical training to non-lawyers

Skills & Expertise

  • Qualified as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales and/or admitted to practise as an attorney in a US state
  • 5+ years' post-qualification experience, ideally in-house in an international business or at a law firm handling comparable commercial work
  • Strong track record in complex commercial negotiations, ideally in affiliate or performance marketing, or in a related sector such as tech, SaaS, AdTech or e-commerce; experience with US commercial contracts, litigation, subpoenas and dispute resolution is a plus
  • Solid M&A experience, including due diligence, transaction documentation and post-closing integration
  • Working knowledge of data protection laws such as GDPR, UK GDPR and US state privacy laws is an advantage
  • Native or native-level English, with excellent drafting and communication skills and the ability to explain complex legal, technical and business matters clearly to non-lawyers; additional languages such as Spanish, French or Portuguese are a plus
  • A keen interest in AI and confidence using AI tools in your daily work, with an eye for how they can make legal work faster and better; knowledge of AI regulation and governance, such as the EU AI Act, is a plus

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: About Peec AI Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win. We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, that went from $0 to $15M ARR in 18 months, with a 100+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend. This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about. The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do. We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings. What we’re looking for 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment. Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code. Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling. Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data. Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry. Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state. Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications. High ownership and low ego. We want people who take responsibility for ambiguous systems, ask sharp questions, and make the team better through clear thinking and kindness. A bias toward durable fixes. You do not stop at “restart the pod” if the real issue is retry amplification, missing backpressure, an unsafe parser assumption, or a provider limit we do not model. Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) als Support-Spezialist - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid. Deine Aufgaben Als Support-Spezialist bist du die freundliche und kompetente Stimme von Deeken Technology für alle Anwender unserer Kunden. Du kümmerst dich um sämtliche IT-Support-Anliegen - und sorgst dafür, dass niemand mit seinem Problem allein bleibt. - Du bist im First- und Second-Level-Support die erste Anlaufstelle: Du nimmst Anfragen telefonisch entgegen und löst sie nach Möglichkeit direkt im ersten Gespräch. - Du bearbeitest schriftliche Anfragen per E-Mail über unsere Service-Plattform Hindeo. - Du analysierst Probleme gemeinsam mit den Anwendern per Fernwartung und findest Lösungen. - Bei Bedarf besprichst du Supportthemen in kurzen Teams-Meetings direkt mit unseren Kunden. - Du gibst Anwendern Tipps, wie sie ihre Systeme besser und sicherer nutzen. - Du stellst die Erreichbarkeit unseres Supports sicher, dokumentierst sauber in Hindeo und gibst komplexe Themen strukturiert an unsere Spezialisten weiter. - Erkennst du beim Kunden Bedarf, übergibst du die Vertriebschance an unsere Kollegen im IT-Vertrieb. Das bringst du mit Verlässlichkeit ist uns extrem wichtig: Wenn du etwas zusagst, hältst du es ein. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation - Erfahrung im IT-Support oder Service Desk, idealerweise in einem Systemhaus - Ein gutes Grundverständnis in einem möglichst breiten Spektrum: Microsoft 365, Nextcloud, Terminalserver, Drucker, Smartphones, Tablets und Thin Clients - Sicherer Umgang mit Fernwartungs-Tools und Ticketsystemen - Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, Geduld und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise - auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, behältst du den Überblick - Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 Prozent, aber passt menschlich und fachlich im Kern? Investorenkommunikation: Du verfasst regelmäßige Investor-Updates und gestaltest die Storyline unseres Pitch Decks mit. Neugier: Interesse an komplexen Technologien und die Motivation, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und verständlich zu vermitteln. Arbeitsweise: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und arbeitest gleichzeitig eng mit anderen zusammen. Du wechselst zwischen Strategie und Umsetzung, ohne eines von beidem aus dem Blick zu verlieren. Schreiben: Du schreibst gut und gerne selbst. Aus einem technischen Gespräch mit einem Engineer machst du eine Case Study oder Website-Copy, die Einkäufer:innen in der Industrie verstehen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Der Prozess: Intro Call, Deep Dive in deine bisherige Arbeit, Besuch bei uns mit einer kleinen Case Study, Angebot. description: Dein Einstieg bei Deeken Technology Du willst IT nicht nur betreiben, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen - für Systeme und für die Menschen, die damit arbeiten? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Deeken Technology ist ein etabliertes IT-Systemhaus aus dem Oldenburger Münsterland - seit über 10 Jahren am Markt, mit einem motivierten und engagierten Team. Wir betreuen mittelständische Unternehmen ganzheitlich: IT-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, Digitalisierung und Telekommunikation. Dabei verkaufen wir keine Einmal-Lösungen, sondern sind langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden - wir kennen ihre Systeme, ihre Abläufe und ihre Ansprechpartner. Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid. Deine Aufgaben Bei uns ist jeder Spezialist in seinem Fachgebiet - niemand muss alles können. Dein Schwerpunkt sind die Microsoft-Umgebungen unserer Kunden, vom Serverraum bis in die Cloud. - Du installierst, aktualisierst und betreust Domänencontroller sowie File- und Anwendungsserver - On-Premise und in Cloud-Umgebungen. - Du administrierst Microsoft 365, insbesondere Exchange Online, Entra ID und Intune. - Du richtest Clients ein und erstellst dafür die passenden Intune-Richtlinien und Bereitstellungspläne. - Du installierst Fachanwendungen unserer Kunden wie ERP- oder Dokumentenmanagement-Systeme, begleitest Updates und stimmst dich dabei mit den Softwareherstellern ab. - Du bindest Kundeninfrastrukturen in unser Monitoring ein - damit wir Probleme erkennen, bevor unsere Kunden sie bemerken. - Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kollegen aus den anderen Fachbereichen zusammen, erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und dokumentierst sauber in unserer Service-Plattform Hindeo. Das bringst du mit Fachwissen ist wichtig - Haltung entscheidet. Zwei Dinge sind uns deshalb bei jeder Einstellung besonders wichtig: Du kommunizierst klar und gern, mit Kunden genauso wie im Team. Und du übernimmst Verantwortung: Was du anfängst, bringst du zu Ende. - Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation - Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration von Windows Server und Active Directory, idealerweise in einem Systemhaus - Fundierte Praxis mit Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID und Intune - Wünschenswert: Virtualisierung (Proxmox), Netzwerkgrundlagen - Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an wechselnden Kundenumgebungen - Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie einen Führerschein der Klasse B Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 Prozent, aber passt menschlich und fachlich im Kern? Dann bewirb dich trotzdem - wir sprechen lieber einmal mehr miteinander. Warum Deeken Technology - Dein eigener Firmenwagen: Nach der Probezeit stellen wir dir einen inkl. Privatnutzung Firmenwagen zur Verfügung. - Dein Fitnessstudio-Abo: Für deinen Ausgleich zum Job bekommst du von uns ein Fitnessabo. - Software, die wir selbst bauen: Wir arbeiten mit Hindeo, unserer eigenen IT-Service-Plattform. In den letzten zwölf Monaten komplett neu entwickelt, gehört sie zu den modernsten Lösungen für Systemhäuser - und dein Feedback fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung ein. - Sicherheit mit Anspruch: Als eines der wenigen IT-Unternehmen der Region sind wir nach ISO 27001 zertifiziert. Du arbeitest nach Standards, auf die du stolz sein kannst. - Herstellerschulungen: Je nach Bedarf und Interesse absolvierst du Schulungen unserer Produktpartner, z. B. Hornetsecurity, WatchGuard, IONOS Cloud und CrowdStrike. - Neues Büro im ecopark: Knapp 500 m² im OM-Medienhaus - hell, klimatisiert, mit kontrollierter Belüftung, barrierefrei und mit Mensa im Haus. Getränke, Snacks und ein frischer Obstkorb stehen für dich bereit. - Ankommen ohne Stress: Kostenlose Parkplätze direkt am Haus. Für Elektrofahrzeuge stehen E-Ladesäulen bereit. - Top-Ausstattung: Aktuellste Hardware, Firmenlaptop, Firmenhandy und Home-Office-Ausstattung. - Hybrid & flexibel: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und nach der Einarbeitung ein Tag mobiles Arbeiten pro Woche. - Extras: Edenred und Mitarbeiterrabatte. - Familie & Beruf: Über die Kita-Kooperation im ecopark stehen in einem benachbarten Kindergarten reservierte Plätze für Kinder von Beschäftigten im ecopark zur Verfügung. - Sicherheit & Miteinander: Unbefristeter Vertrag, 28 Urlaubstage, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, lockerer Dresscode sowie gemeinsame Teamevents - vom Stoppelmarkt über das Cityfest bis zur Weihnachtsfeier. maintainable, consistent, and beautiful Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health You'll be a great fit for this role if you: Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and collaborative environment Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team Why you Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. title: DACH Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation (m/f/d)
description: DACH Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation (m/f/d) Position Summary: We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to the VP of Global GTM. We are seeking an elite, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across top-tier accounts. Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world's most mission-critical ERP environments. Key Responsibilities Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. The SAP "Triple Threat": Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles. SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations. GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations. C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity). Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base. Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP's rigorous reporting standards. Required Skills/Experience: Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner). Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) . Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees. Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP's regional field teams. Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO. Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.Languages: Professional fluency in both German and English (written and spoken). What You will get: You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, an attractive salary and extensive benefits (including JobRad, Focus Friday and much more). You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement. We support our employees with 5 fully paid sick days per child and subsidize childcare up to primary school age. In addition to an individual onboarding and buddy program, we offer comprehensive training opportunities and english language classes. We offer 30 days of paid vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) for optimal work-life balance. Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication. Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms. The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP. About Onapsis: Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. title: Account Director, Central Banks & Regulators (EMEA)
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. TRM helps governments and financial institutions detect and disrupt illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to central banks, financial regulators and financial intelligence units across EMEA. You will own the relationships and the revenue in a territory where digital asset supervision is growing fast, setting account strategy and closing six- and seven-figure deals with institutions that have long, careful buying processes. What makes this seat unusual is the chance to shape how TRM serves supervisors as MiCA and the EU AML package reshape their work. The impact you will have: Map your territory’s central banks, supervisors and FIUs, using AI tools to identify budget holders, decision-makers, champions and regulatory triggers so your first outreach reaches the right person. Win six- and seven-figure deals by turning each institution’s supervisory and enforcement challenges into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans that you sharpen with your own judgment. Build and maintain 3x qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, regional events and campaigns with Marketing, and measure what converts. Navigate tenders, frameworks and call-offs with Solutions Architecture, Legal and Deal Desk, so each response is accurate and on time. Grow live customers through renewals, expansion and referrals, using AI summaries of usage and call notes to spot expansion signals early. Bring supervisory and customer insight back to Policy, Product and Marketing so the next release reflects how regulators in your region work. What we’re looking for: 6+ years selling SaaS, data intelligence or investigative solutions into central banks, financial regulators, FIUs or comparable government accounts in EMEA. A record of closing six- and seven-figure deals and meeting quota across long, multi-stakeholder cycles. Existing relationships within EMEA central banks, supervisors or FIUs, and credibility with senior officials. Working knowledge of MiCA, the EU AML framework and how public sector buyers procure. Hands-on use of AI for account research, planning and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained. Credible, clear communication with senior executives, in person and virtually, and a knack for storytelling. Fluent English; additional European languages are a plus. Based in France, Belgium, Spain, Netherlands, willingness to travel regularly across the region. About the Team: TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director real ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it. The team is fast-paced, positive and collaborative, with shared pipeline insight and open sharing of what works. The work is hard in a useful way: senior public sector buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a category that is new to many supervisors. You will work with Partnerships, Legal, Marketing, Policy and Product, who move quickly to back your deals. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Within your first 30 days, you profile and stack-rank every central bank, regulator and FIU in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends. When a regulator sends an urgent request late on a Friday for a same-day conversation and demo, you and TRM’s Solutions team make it happen that day. When a government RFx lands with only a few days to respond, you rally Solutions Architecture and Deal Desk to deliver a high-quality response on time. Team Operating Rhythms: Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, with occasional later calls for US-EMEA opportunities. Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses. Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and fortnightly pod calls. Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission. Required online and collaboration hours: Schedule: UK and CET core hours, with flexibility for occasional US-EMEA calls. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. Acting as the vital bridge between business requirements and technical execution, you will master the configuration of existing solutions and be the technical lead for new application/service implementations. title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
description: We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions. The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces. How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it? About Nelly We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people. Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality. What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable. Joining us, you will: Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs What you'll bring: Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product 7+ years of product management experience Even better if you have: Built and shipped AI products Worked on data platforms or data products Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry Professional German language knowledge Our Interview Process: Introduction to Nelly with TA Product craft interview with our Product manager Case study interview with Director of Product Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders What we offer: The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it. Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still. A yearly learning and development budget , plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning. A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact. Deutschlandticket or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast. Urban Sports Club membership , for sport and balance. Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup. Up to 4 weeks of workation. A dog friendly office with great vibes and a team that is fun to work with. We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. Dein Wohnort in Deutschland ist zweitrangig – wichtig ist deine hohe Reisebereitschaft und deine WEG-Expertise. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen, reibungslosem WEG-Tagesgeschäft und lokalen Teams, die mit der Buena-Software spürbar besser arbeiten als vorher. Verantwortlichkeiten Du tauchst tief in das WEG-Tagesgeschäft unserer neu übernommenen Verwaltungen ein, identifizierst Engpässe frühzeitig und baust bestehende Rückstände gezielt ab. Du begleitest und steuerst die operative Umstellung auf unsere Buena-Software direkt vor Ort bei den Teams. Du schulst die Teams praxisnah an unserer Software und befähigst sie, Versammlungen, Beschlüsse und das Tagesgeschäft digital abzuwickeln. Du bringst deine tiefen WEG-Erfahrungen aus den Einsätzen zurück in unser Product-Team, um unsere Software stetig zu verbessern. Du passt gut, wenn du Du hast mehrjährige fundierte Praxiserfahrung in der WEG-Verwaltung und kennst Versammlungen, Beschluss-Sammlungen und WEG-Sonderfälle im Detail. Hohe Reisebereitschaft mitbringst und flexibel regelmäßig vor Ort bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland arbeitest. Probleme vor Ort schnell analysierst, Prioritäten setzt und ohne Berührungsängste selbst mit anpackst. Empathisch und klar kommunizierst, schnell Vertrauen bei bestehenden Teams aufbaust und Menschen für neue, digitale Arbeitsweisen gewinnst. Tech-affin bist und komplexe Software schnell durchdringst, um sie anderen einfach zu erklären. Deutsch auf C2-Niveau sprichst. Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest. Warum jetzt einsteigen Du bist die Schlüsselperson vor Ort: Mit über 90.000 Einheiten und 30+ übernommenen Verwaltungen wachsen wir schnell. Jede neue Hausverwaltung wird erst durch dich zu einem echten Buena-Betrieb. Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt schnell große Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor drei Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor zwei Jahren Chief of Staff. Echter Impact: Die deutsche Hausverwaltung läuft vielerorts noch auf Papier und Excel. Du stellst das vor Ort auf moderne Technologie um. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Growth Consultant (m/w/d), Account Management für 30 bis 40 B2B Tech Kunden in Berlin Die meisten Account-Management-Jobs heißen Beratung und bestehen am Ende aus Reporting-Decks und Ticket-Pingpong. Hier ist es umgekehrt: Die Umsetzung macht das Team, du berätst. Unser Kunde ist eine AI-first GTM Agentur aus Berlin Mitte. Seit 2024 auf über 5 Mio. EUR ARR und 30+ Leute gewachsen, mit 200+ B2B Tech Kunden, von der Mobility-App über einen Schweizer Telko-Konzern bis zum Bildungsverlag. Zuletzt kam in einem einzigen Monat über 1 Mio. EUR neuer ARR dazu. Jeder dieser Kunden braucht jemanden, der ihn hält und ausbaut. Genau dafür ist dieser Seat da. Das Paket: 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention, Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage Office und 2 Tage remote. Tasks Du führst dein eigenes Portfolio aus ca. 30 bis 40 Accounts und sitzt alle zwei Wochen mit Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern im Termin. Deine Kunden sind B2B Software- und Tech-Firmen, die über Google, LinkedIn, Meta und signalbasiertes Outbound ihre Pipeline aufbauen. Insgesamt laufen jeden Monat sechsstellige Budgets in Paid Search und Paid Social über die Agentur. Der typische Moment: Ein Geschäftsführer, der viel Geld in Ads und Outbound steckt, fragt dich, warum seine Leads teurer geworden sind und ob er das Budget kürzen soll. Du hast die Antwort und den nächsten Schritt. Beratung statt Operatives: Kampagnen bauen die GTM- und Performance-Marketing-Teams. Du entscheidest mit dem Kunden, was als Nächstes gebaut wird. Upsell und Retention sind dein Hebel: neuer Kanal, mehr Budget, Verlängerung. Dein Spielfeld ist das bestehende Portfolio. Du liest die Zahlen deiner Accounts (Leads, Cost per Lead, Pipeline) und siehst ein Abwanderungsrisiko, bevor der Kunde es ausspricht. Requirements Ein paar Jahre B2B mit echter, eigener Kundenverantwortung. Ob als Account Manager, BDM, kommerzielles Customer Success, AE mit Bestandskunden oder Founder’s Associate, der Titel ist egal. Interne Koordination oder reines Projektmanagement zählt hier nicht. Du erzählst deinen Track Record in Zahlen: wie viele Accounts, welche Retention, wie viel Upsell-Volumen. Wenn dir ein Geschäftsführer im Call sagt, die Leads taugen nichts und er überlegt zu kündigen, gehst du in die Daten statt in die Defensive und kommst mit einem Plan raus. Du hältst 30+ Kunden parallel auf dem Schirm, ohne dass einer durchrutscht, und baust dir dafür dein eigenes System. Du brauchst niemanden, der dir den Tag plant. Du siehst die Lücke und schließt sie. Idealerweise hast du Outbound, Lead Gen oder B2B-Akquise schon selbst gemacht. Pluspunkte: Google oder LinkedIn Ads, CRM, Agentur-, Consulting- oder Startup-Background. Fix: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, gutes Englisch, Festanstellung in Vollzeit, 3 Tage pro Woche im Berliner Office (der erste Monat komplett vor Ort). Early Career bis Mid. Gesucht ist Hunger, nicht Seniorität: Wer seit Jahren Senior Advisory macht, wird hier nicht glücklich. Ein Abschluss oder ein großes Logo im Lebenslauf sind nicht das Tor, deine Zahlen schon. Benefits 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention. Du verdienst also auch daran, dass Kunden bleiben, nicht nur an neuen Deals. Perspektive: Die Agentur sucht explizit Leute, die Experten- oder Führungsverantwortung übernehmen wollen. Lernkurve: Alle zwei Wochen sitzt du mit Geschäftsführern aus 30 bis 40 verschiedenen B2B Tech Firmen am Tisch. Nach 12 Monaten kannst du einem GF sagen, welcher Kanal sich für sein Geschäftsmodell rechnet und welcher nicht. 1:1 Coaching mit erfahrenen Leuten ab Tag 1. Office in Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage vor Ort und 2 remote, MacBook und eigener Platz mit Bildschirm. Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club M, regelmäßige Team-Abende. Start: ASAP Closing Klingt nach dir? Die Bewerbung dauert zwei Minuten, kein Motivationsschreiben. So läuft’s: Bewerbung ➝ Talent Call mit uns ➝ 10 Min Kennenlernen beim Kunden ➝ 30 bis 45 Min Deep Dive ➝ ca. 90 Min vor Ort mit den Gründern und dem Team ➝ Rückmeldung innerhalb von 2 Tagen. Warum über GENZ4GTM: Vor jedem Kundengespräch bekommst du von uns ein Cheatsheet, nach jeder Runde ehrliches Feedback, und mit einer Bewerbung matchen wir dich auf mehrere passende Rollen. title: Engineering Manager Scheduling Team (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join the Scheduling team in Berlin.

Your mission will be to give practitioners their day back:  reclaiming the admin time they spend creating and managing appointments, so care teams can focus on what matters. You will work in a feature team developing scheduling infrastructure and booking experiences, contributing directly to a platform that books billions of appointments a year for health professionals and patients across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead a team of 6 to 7 engineers of mixed seniority, owning delivery, quality and production health end to end — keeping engagement high and standards higher
  • Together with your product partner, define the mission and vision for your team and build a roadmap you can defend to stakeholders
  • Take part in architecture reviews and help shape the technical direction of the Scheduling stream, including the migration of core scheduling capabilities from the monolith into purpose-built services
  • Set and uphold the security, reliability, performance and scalability standards required to remain the most trusted e-health SaaS in Europe
  • Partner with Talent and People teams to recruit, develop and retain engineers through career conversations and feedback they can act on
  • Embed AI-assisted engineering into how your team works day to day, with a clear and honest view of where it helps and where it does not
  • Continuously improve how the team operates — planning, on-call, bug backlog, incident follow-up — so the team spends its energy on what moves the needle

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have at least 6 years of software engineering experience and 3 years of engineering management experience, including leading a team of 5+ engineers through delivery, hiring and growth
  • Are credible with senior backend engineers — distributed systems, data modelling, latency and throughput are conversations you can hold and challenge; you stay close enough to the code to review a pull request, without needing to be the one writing it
  • Have hands-on experience modernising a large legacy system, ideally extracting services from a monolith, and know how to keep a team delivering while the ground moves
  • Are an effective communicator who can translate company goals into team objectives, and who says the uncomfortable thing early rather than late
  • Think critically and objectively, with a solution-oriented approach that brings people with you

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have worked in a regulated industry such as healthcare or fintech, where privacy and data protection shape design decisions
  • Have navigated hyper-growth environments and understand the trade-offs they force on architecture and team organisation
  • Have formed a considered view on AI coding assistants — their real benefits and their real shortcomings

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
  • Our stack in this product area is Ruby on Rails and TypeScript/React in the monolith, Kotlin for new services, with Postgres, Redis and Kafka underneath.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib
  • 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz
  • Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)
  • The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more
  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club
  • A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode
  • Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit
  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
  • Relocation support in case of international mobility
  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Recruiter Interview
  • System Design Interview
  • Behavioral Interview
  • Engineering Manager Case
  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position
  • Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Kotlin
  • Full-time
  • Location: Berlin
  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: Germany | France | Italy | Netherlands. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

title: Senior Returns Manager, EU
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Returns Manager to own end-to-end reverse logistics performance across our UK and EU operations. From forecasting incoming volume through grading, refunds, fraud prevention, and resale, you'll build a returns operation that's fast, accurate, and cost-efficient — while turning returned inventory back into recovered value. This is a hands-on role for someone who can dig into root causes, manage partners and carriers, and build the reporting to prove it's working.

What You'll Do

Returns Forecasting & Planning

  • Build and maintain returns volume forecasting models across UK and EU markets, factoring in seasonality, backlog, promotions, and category-level return patterns
  • Translate forecasts into staffing, processing capacity, and warehouse space plans for returns operations
  • Monitor returns rate trends and flag volume shifts to inventory, finance, and merchandising teams

 

Customer Refunds

  • Oversee timely, accurate refund processing in line with UK and EU consumer rights regulations
  • Audit warehouse/QRC staff on grading standards and quality checks
  • Partner with customer service and finance to resolve refund discrepancies and disputes
  • Track refund turnaround time against SLA and resolve bottlenecks in the refund workflow

 

Fraud Detection & Prevention

  • Build and refine fraud detection processes for returns abuse (wardrobing, serial returners, empty-box claims, item-not-as-described fraud)
  • Partner with risk and customer service teams to develop fraud rules/flags and investigate high-risk cases
  • Balance fraud prevention with customer experience, avoiding over-blocking of legitimate returns

 

Returns Root Cause & Logistics Feedback

  • Track and categorize return reasons, with particular focus on logistics-driven returns (damaged in transit, wrong item shipped, late or failed delivery, packaging failure)
  • Partner with warehouse, supply chain, and carrier teams to reduce logistics-driven returns through root cause analysis and corrective action
  • Present return reason trends to leadership to inform packaging, product, and logistics improvements

 

Returns Resale & Recommerce

  • Manage resale/recommerce channels for graded inventory (open-box, refurbished, clearance, secondary market and liquidation partners)
  • Maximize recovery value on returned inventory while minimizing time-to-resale
  • Build and manage relationships with resale/liquidation partners and evaluate new recommerce channels across UK and EU markets

 

Reverse Logistics & Carrier Management

  • Negotiate rates and service levels with carriers for return shipments across UK and EU markets
  • Manage carrier performance for return pickups, label generation, and inbound transit times
  • Evaluate and roll out returns-specific shipping options (paperless returns, drop-off points, pickup services) to reduce cost and improve the customer experience

 

SLA & Performance Management

  • Define and manage SLAs across the returns lifecycle — receipt to grading, grading to disposition, refund turnaround, and time-to-resale
  • Monitor 3PL and warehouse partner performance against returns SLAs; escalate and resolve issues as needed
  • Build reporting and dashboards to track returns KPIs and turn data into actionable recommendations for leadership

 

Cross-Functional & Compliance

  • Partner with customer service, supply chain, finance, and merchandising to align returns operations with broader business goals
  • Ensure returns operations comply with UK and EU consumer protection, distance selling, and VAT/duty rules (including treatment of re-imported goods and refund-related VAT adjustments)
  • Stay current on evolving returns-related regulation across UK and EU markets

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 5–8+ years managing returns or reverse logistics operations in a high-volume ecommerce or retail environment, ideally across UK and EU markets
  • Experience building returns forecasting and capacity planning models
  • Solid understanding of UK and EU consumer rights, refund, and distance-selling regulations
  • Experience designing or managing returns fraud detection and prevention programs
  • Track record reducing logistics-driven returns through root cause analysis and cross-functional fixes
  • Experience managing return resale, refurbishment, or liquidation channels
  • Carrier negotiation experience for reverse logistics/return shipping
  • Strong SLA and KPI management skills, with reporting experience (Excel, SQL, or BI tools)
  • Hands-on experience with WMS/OMS returns modules
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills

 

Preferred

  • Experience in DTC, fashion/apparel, or other high-return-rate ecommerce categories
  • Familiarity with recommerce or liquidation platforms and partners
  • Experience operating across multiple EU countries and languages
  • Background in fraud/risk analytics
  • Experience managing reverse logistics SLAs with UK/EU carriers (e.g., Royal Mail, Evri, DPD, DHL, GLS)



WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
description: Description QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question. This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join QuantumDiamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Build the checks, from raw quantum sensor signal to field map, that tell a trustworthy measurement from a measurement or reconstruction artifact, on lab and customer data alike. Trace a failed check to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Keep the catalogue of known artifacts and the set of reference measurements that make every new verdict faster and more defensible. Validate the team's evaluation methods against simulation and reference measurements before they go into daily use. Give our Applications Engineers and the team a clear verdict on each measurement, and feed what breaks back into the next generation of the QDm. What is expected of you 3+ years of professional experience outside academia applying data science to measurement or imaging data from physical instruments. A degree in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics or a related discipline; a PhD is welcome, not required. Solid statistics and signal or image processing: you ask where a signal comes from, tell it from noise and systematics, and show it with numbers. Fluency in Python and the scientific stack, with version control and tests as a habit. AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own. Comfortable operating our systems in the lab when your analysis needs data. Fluent English; German is an advantage, not a requirement. On-site in Munich. Experience with magnetic or electromagnetic measurements or semiconductor failure analysis is a plus. What we cannot teach on the job is rigor with real measurement data and the habit of turning one analysis into a method the team can reuse, and that is exactly what we want you to bring. Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. About us QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act. This is a full-time, 6-month internship at our well-connected location in Munich, starting as soon as possible. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join QuantumDiamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Support the assembly, alignment, and characterization of optical and optomechanical setups for our QDM. Support building and testing cooling systems in the lab. Carry out measurements using our lab equipment, including interferometric and thermal measurements. Take on basic electronics tasks such as soldering and cabling. Create and maintain technical documentation, such as assembly procedures, alignment protocols, and test reports. What is expected of you Currently pursuing or holding a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physics, Quantum Science, Engineering Physics, Photonics, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related field. First hands-on lab experience with optical or optomechanical setups, for example through lab courses, projects, or your thesis Basic electronics knowledge and first experience with measurement equipment and soldering. A careful, structured way of working and a genuine interest in documenting things well. Curiosity and eagerness to learn in a fast-moving, hands-on environment. Nice to have: Experience with interferometry or cooling systems, knowledge of quantum optics, first experience with Zemax or SolidWorks. Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. About us QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.
