title: Content Creator & Social Media Manager (m/w/d) – Fußball Amateur- & Profisport
description: Mach Vereinsgeschichten sichtbar Du fühlst Dich auf dem Sportplatz wohl, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und hast Ideen für Videos, die man sich bis zum Ende anschaut? Du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera und kannst Deine Inhalte eigenständig drehen und schneiden? Wir bei stickerfive entwickeln und produzieren individuelle Stickeralben für den Amateur- und Profisport sowie für Unternehmen und besondere Themenwelten. Bei uns bekommen Vereinsmitglieder ihren eigenen Sticker, Fans sammeln ihre Mannschaft und am Spielfeldrand wird getauscht. Dahinter stecken Geschichten, die wir auf Social Media bisher viel zu selten erzählen. Unsere Kanäle und unsere Reichweite möchten wir deshalb gezielt ausbauen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der diesen Bereich mit eigenen Ideen und praktischer Erfahrung voranbringt. Deine Aufgaben Content entwickeln und produzieren: Du setzt Ideen für Reels, TikToks und Stories um. Vom Konzept über den Dreh bis zum Schnitt und zur Veröffentlichung begleitest Du Deine Inhalte selbst. Vor der Kamera stehen: Du stellst unsere Sammelaktionen vor, führst kurze Interviews und gibst Einblicke in den Alltag bei stickerfive. Vereine begleiten: Du besuchst Fotoshootings, Verkaufsstarts und Tauschbörsen. Dabei fängst Du die Stimmung ein und kommst mit den Menschen vor Ort ins Gespräch. Unsere Kanäle betreuen: Du entwickelst einen Redaktionsplan, veröffentlichst regelmäßig und kümmerst Dich um Kommentare und Nachrichten. Reichweite und Community aufbauen: Du entwickelst wiederkehrende Formate und Inhalte, die Menschen gerne anschauen, teilen und kommentieren. Passende Trends greifst Du auf und übersetzt sie in Ideen für stickerfive. Ergebnisse auswerten: Du schaust Dir an, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab. Dabei interessieren Dich beispielsweise Wiedergabedauer, geteilte Beiträge und die Entwicklung unserer Community. Drehs und Inhalte organisieren: Du stimmst Dich mit unseren Vereinen sowie mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb ab. Du planst Termine und kümmerst Dich rechtzeitig um die Informationen und Materialien, die Du benötigst. Was du mitbringst Du hast bereits selbst Social-Media-Inhalte produziert und kannst uns konkrete Beispiele zeigen. Ob für ein Unternehmen, einen Verein oder Deinen eigenen Kanal, ist dabei zweitrangig. Uns interessiert, was Du selbst umgesetzt hast und was Du daraus gelernt hast. Außerdem wünschen wir uns: Interesse am Sport, besonders am Amateur- und Vereinsleben. Vielleicht bist Du selbst im Verein aktiv oder begleitest schon eine Mannschaft mit der Kamera. Freude daran, vor der Kamera zu sprechen und auch auf fremde Menschen offen zuzugehen. Einen sicheren Umgang mit Smartphone oder Kamera und einem Schnittprogramm wie CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve. Ein Gespür für gute Einstiege, verständliche Geschichten und das passende Tempo eines Videos. Gute deutsche Ausdrucksfähigkeit, sowohl beim Sprechen als auch beim Schreiben. Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise. Du bringst Ideen ein, organisierst deren Umsetzung und sprichst offene Fragen oder Hindernisse frühzeitig an. Bereitschaft zu Drehs bei unseren Partnervereinen, in der Regel am Wochenende. Eine bestimmte Ausbildung oder ein Studium setzen wir nicht voraus. Deine Arbeitsproben und Deine Fähigkeiten zählen. Eine große eigene Followerschaft brauchst Du ebenfalls nicht. Erfahrung mit bezahlter Werbung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du hast bereits mit Meta Ads oder TikTok Ads gearbeitet und Kampagnen zur Gewinnung neuer Interessenten betreut? Dann kannst Du diese Erfahrung bei uns einbringen und je nach Kenntnisstand auch Kampagnen übernehmen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Content und dem Aufbau unserer Social-Media-Kanäle. Dein Gestaltungsspielraum Unser Social-Media-Auftritt (Facebook & Instagram) ist ziemlich mau. Auf TikTok sind wir noch nicht aktiv. Du kannst deshalb von Beginn an mitprägen, wie stickerfive auftritt. Vielleicht begleitest Du eine Mannschaft, die zum ersten Mal ihr eigenes Album sieht. Vielleicht entwickelst Du ein Interviewformat am Spielfeldrand oder zeigst, wie aus einem Mannschaftsfoto ein Sticker wird. Wir suchen jemanden, der solche Ideen mitbringt und sie umsetzt. Gemeinsam legen wir Ziele und Prioritäten fest. Du bekommst Raum, neue Formate auszuprobieren, und arbeitest eng mit den Menschen zusammen, die unsere Sammelprojekte betreuen. Das erwartet Dich bei uns Geschichten direkt aus dem Sport: Du lernst Amateurvereine kennen und erhältst Einblicke in unsere Projekte mit dem Profisport. Kreativer Freiraum: Du entwickelst eigene Formate und prägst den Auftritt von stickerfive mit. Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Du arbeitest direkt mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb zusammen. Abwechslung zwischen Büro und Sportplatz: Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in Gräfelfing bei München. Wie oft Du wirklich am Ende vor Ort in Gräfelfing bei München oder im Homeoffice bist, kommt auf Deinen Wohnort an. Für Drehs bist Du auch bei unseren Partnervereinen unterwegs. Ausstattung und Flexibilität: Du erhältst ein Firmenhandy und bei Bedarf auch einen Firmenlaptop. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten stimmen wir passend zu Drehs und Teamterminen ab. Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Ob Stadionbesuch oder Wiesn, auch außerhalb unserer Projekte unternehmen wir etwas zusammen. Extras im Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee sowie Mitarbeiterrabatte gehören ebenfalls dazu. Zeig uns, was Du machst Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder einen kurzen Überblick über Deinen bisherigen Weg sowie Arbeitsproben. Besonders interessieren uns Videos, die Du selbst konzipiert, gedreht oder geschnitten hast. Bei gemeinsamen Projekten schreib bitte kurz dazu, welche Aufgaben Du übernommen hast. Mindestens eines der Beispiele sollte Dich vor der Kamera zeigen. Falls Du dazu noch nichts Passendes hast, reicht auch ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo mit dem Smartphone. Erzähl uns außerdem, welchen Bezug Du zum Sport hast, wann Du anfangen könntest und welchen Stundenumfang und welches Gehalt Du Dir vorstellst. About Us

LogicMonitor is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. By anticipating issues before they occur, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences.

Our customers value LogicMonitor's ability to unify cloud and traditional IT into a single platform, reflected in strong retention, expansion, and customer advocacy. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work and one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for multiple consecutive years.

We are seeking a driven Account Executive ready to operate as a modern enterprise seller. This is an opportunity to join a high-growth organisation with a strong market position, large territories, and a powerful sales engine. You will leverage data, AI, and a consultative approach to drive meaningful impact across enterprise accounts.

  • Exceed Targets: Consistently achieve and surpass pipeline and revenue goals.

title: Senior Solution Architect - Enterprise
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role

Are you looking to make a real impact and play a meaningful role in the growth of our company?

As a Solutions Architect at Elastic you will serve as a technical authority and trusted advisor to our sales team, customers, partners and community. You will understand and solve our customer’s business issues with the Elastic Stack, engage the regional Elastic community through events and programs, and enable sales through our Partners. A successful SA at Elastic will be focused on excellence; taking the initiative to improve both themselves and the team through continuous learning and questioning the status quo.

Why Elastic and this Team? “Once I started, I was blown away to realize, what was always so obvious, everything is search. Anything you do with data involves search, every app needs search, even analytics are about search. Daily I am blown away with the types of things our users and customers are doing with search.” Director of Product, Elastic. “We question the status quo, debate the best ways to accomplish our goals and hold ourselves and our teams to the highest standards of performance. We take pride in our ability to understand our customers needs and make recommendations that are based on extensive global experience across multiple use cases. We learn from our mistakes and losses and celebrate our successes with an eye towards constant improvement. Join this team if you are up for a compassionate, understanding and fair environment where you can really grow into the next phase of your career.” VP WW Solution Architecture, Elastic

What You Will Be Doing 

  • Serving as the technical point of contact for your accounts and account managers in your assigned territory.
  • Developing a deep understanding of customers’ goals and objectives, and articulating how our offerings address their needs.
  • Creating and owning value based relationships at all levels in customer organizations.
  • Actively participating in all phases of planning and execution for your territory, from initial discovery to the technical win.
  • Developing and maintaining a deep understanding of the Elastic products and solutions to demonstrate the value of our offerings in sales meetings, and at events such as meetups and conferences.
  • Advising the sales team on effective ways of positioning Elastic products, solutions and services.
  • Onboarding, educating and enabling our partners, and supporting them in sales cycles.
  • Creating collateral, contributing to programs and collaborating with other Elasticians to meet individual client needs.
  • Being the voice of the customer and community to communicate needs, gaps, and enhancements to our engineering and leadership teams.

What is The Role

Elastic Security is one of the fastest-growing parts of our business, and our customers (including government and public sector organisations) rely on our Security Solution to modernise their SOC, threat detection, and response capabilities.

You will lead the hands-on delivery of Elastic Security projects (new implementations, migrations, and use-case expansions) from discovery through architecture design and build. Along the way, you'll develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and work closely with our Services, Engineering and Sales teams.

Elastic is a remote-first company, but many of the projects you'll deliver might require onsite availability, making the role hybrid in practice, varying by project, with travel of up to 60%.
Some of these engagements, given the organisations involved, also require national security screening or clearance; eligibility to obtain one in your country of employment is a strong advantage, and Elastic will sponsor the process where required.

Assess and Design

  • Analyse customer goals, pain points, existing architecture, and threat landscape, translating them into technical requirements
  • Design Elastic Security solution architectures (SIEM, endpoint, cloud security) that integrate with the customer's wider security ecosystem
  • Advise on the customer's security strategy and own the Elastic side of it, aligning recommendations through regular sessions with senior and key stakeholders

Implement and Deliver

  • Scripting skills, ideally in Python, and exposure to modern delivery practices such as Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD are strongly preferred

  • Eligibility to obtain national security clearance in your country of employment (screening sponsored by Elastic where required)

  • Strong proficiency in both English (our company-wide operating language) and the local market language.

title: Strategische:r Einkäufer:in – Halbleitermaterialien (w/m/d)
description: Über uns Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwas grundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern. Unsere Technologie Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung. Kurz gesagt , wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen. Deine Rolle In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. Du stellst die Versorgungssicherheit sicher, optimierst die Gesamtkosten über den gesamten Beschaffungslebenszyklus hinweg und gewährleistest die Einhaltung der Qualitätsanforderungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen. Deine Aufgaben Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, globale Beschaffungsstrategien für Halbleitermaterialien wie Wafer, Fotolacke, CMP-Suspensionen, Spezialgase oder Chemikalien zu entwickeln und zu implementieren. Du identifizierst, qualifizierst und steuerst strategisch wichtige Lieferanten und stellst dabei sicher, dass sie optimal auf unsere Technologie-Roadmaps, Qualitätsstandards und Produktionsanforderungen abgestimmt sind. Beim Verhandeln von Verträgen, Preisen und sonstigen Konditionen hast du unsere Kostenziele immer im Blick und sicherst gleichzeitig eine verlässliche Belieferung. Darüber hinaus beobachtest du kontinuierlich die Märkte für Halbleitermaterialien, die Leistung der Lieferanten, Preistrends sowie Risiken in der Lieferkette, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus R&D, Process Engineering, Qualitätssicherung und Fertigung stimmst du die Materialbeschaffung bestmöglich auf die technologischen Vorgaben und Produktionsanforderungen ab. Bei der Einführung neuer Produkte unterstützt du tatkräftig, indem du Materialien beschaffst, die den neuen Prozessanforderungen und Skalierungszielen gerecht werden. Du steuerst die Performance, pflegst die Lieferantenbeziehungen und kümmerst dich um das Reporting in Bezug auf unsere Unternehmensziele. Das bringst du mit Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Supply Chain Management, Ingenieur- oder Materialwissenschaften, Physik, BWL (oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang) Mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Einkauf, Strategic Sourcing oder Supply Chain Management, vorzugsweise in der Halbleiterindustrie, Elektronikbranche oder Hightech-Fertigung Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfolge in Bezug auf Vertragsverhandlungen, Lieferantenmanagement und Kostenoptimierung Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Halbleitermaterialien und -prozesse, z. B. Wafer, Spezialgase, Chemikalien, Fotolacke, Lithografie, Ätzen und Metallisierungsmaterialien Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umgang mit ERP- oder Einkaufssystemen und Datenanalysetools Analytisches Denken, Kommunikationsstärke und ein gutes Gespür im Umgang mit verschiedenen Stakeholder:innen Verhandlungssicheres Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus) Die Bereitschaft, mind. 1x pro Woche in unserem Aachener Büro zu arbeiten Unsere Kultur Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel — wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst. Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung. Deine Gesundheit und deine Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden steht an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versicherungs-, Renten- und virtuellen Aktienoptionen für deine geistige, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit. Dein Wohlbefinden ist unsere Priorität — heute und in der Zukunft. Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt. Wir verbinden Chips — und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. title: Associate Director Marketing Lifecycle, CC outbound
description:
The role

The Associate Director for Lifecycle, CC Outbound, owns the outbound call center channel strategy and performance for millions of former customers across all 17 of our international markets and all our brands. We are looking for a CRM expert, who is interested in running strategy for Call Center, with a high level of autonomy and agility. You will own the strategic development, performance and strategic innovations for this channel, working closely with the Call Center Operations team. Your scope includes steering performance and managing budgets, implementing strategies that will unlock a better customer experience, under consideration of country-specific idiosyncrasies. It also means developing this channel into one of our prime sources of insight to customer sentiment and inspiration for product improvements at scale (e.g., through the use of AI tools). Moreover, you will own the performance of this channel, which includes setting targets together with our local market CMOs and day-to-day steering of conversions, cost and ROI together with our VP of customer care and his operations managers. 

If you want to own a critical channel for one of our most valuable customer groups and develop a strong muscle in driving CRM strategy and execution, we want to hear from you!

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • CRM Strategy Development:
    • Develop and implement annual strategic plans for Call Centre Outbound initiatives
    • Manage the CC Outbound for the full customer lifecycle, from leads to reactivation
    • Collaborate with CC Operations, cross-functional teams, local markets and international marketing leadership to align strategies with overall business goals.
  • Personalization of Customer Interaction
    • Work with L&D, Brand and local teams to enrich the training for agents, adding the local context, address the customer needs and have the best pitch for the customer
    • Test personalized offers for customers
    • Utilize AI tools to improve customer interactions and call content
  • Call Centre Outbound Campaign Management:
    • Design and execute outbound communication campaigns. Provide guidance on campaign targeting, messaging, incentives and timing to maximize conversion rates.
    • Own and steer campaign performance, maximizing ROI and effectiveness.
    • Ensure all outbound communication activities comply with relevant regulations and internal expectations (e.g., via quality assurance measures)
  • Data Analysis and Tech Tooling:
    • Leverage data analysis to identify, test and evaluate impactful reactivation strategies and improvement opportunities
    • Evaluate and implement CRM tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of outbound initiatives, coordinating with Call Center Operations and CommsTech.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in and a passion for delivering excellent and effective customer experiences (e.g., working in CRM/Lifecycle Marketing, campaign management, Product, etc.)
  • Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to influence and motivate people at all levels within international environments and across a broad variety of job functions.
  • Strong ownership mentality and drive to deliver results, including experience with prioritizing for highest impact and managing trade-off decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from data
  • Ideally hands-on experience working with or in Call Centres
  • Ideally experience in Experimentation/Testing

What we offer 

  • Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg
  • Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products
  • Development possibilities along with internal trainings and a yearly Learning & Development budget
  • Flexible working hours including Work From Home/Work from Abroad/Sabbatical Policy, as well as a home office set up budget 
  • Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program
  • Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.
  • Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners and yoga classes
  • Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill
  • Childcare and company pension scheme benefit
  • Monthly transportation budget via NAVIT

  • Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.
  • Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.
  • Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.
  • Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

description:

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

About the Team

Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments.
We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.

Your Mission

Support the development, integration, testing, and operational use of tactical data link capabilities for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and wider command-and-control environments. You will help ensure that our systems can communicate reliably and securely with military networks, command posts, allied platforms, and mission systems. A key part of the role is to evaluate, understand, and integrate tactical communication standards and technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military data link solutions. You will translate operational communication requirements into practical integration concepts, test setups, and deployable system configurations.

Responsibilities

 

  • Tactical Data Link Integration: Support the integration of tactical data link capabilities such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military communication systems into STARK platforms and Ground Control Station environments.
  • Interoperability Concepts: Define and support communication concepts that enable reliable data exchange between unmanned systems, GCS setups, command centers, allied platforms, and external mission systems.
  • Requirements Translation: Translate operational and military communication requirements into technical integration requirements, interface definitions, test needs, and subsystem-level implementation concepts.
  • System Interface Support: Work with engineering, software, network, RF, modem, antenna, and GCS teams to align interfaces, protocols, data flows, configuration requirements, and integration constraints.
  • SATCOM & Beyond-Line-of-Sight Support: Support concepts and integration activities for SATCOM, long-range communication paths, and other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity options.
  • Testing & Validation: Plan and support lab tests, field tests, interoperability checks, and validation activities for tactical data link and communication setups.
  • Security & Reliability: Contribute to secure, robust, and mission-ready communication architectures, considering availability, latency, data integrity, authentication, and operational constraints.
  • Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work with external suppliers, partners, military stakeholders, and internal teams to assess data link options, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility.
  • Documentation: Document data link concepts, interface assumptions, configuration settings, integration dependencies, test results, and recommended operational setups in a clear and maintainable way.

 

Required Skills

 

  • Experience: Around 5 years of professional experience in tactical communications, military data links, SATCOM, RF systems, communication engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Tactical Data Link Knowledge: Practical understanding of military data link technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, or comparable tactical communication systems.
  • Systems Understanding: Ability to understand complex communication architectures involving platforms, radios, antennas, modems, networks, command systems, software interfaces, and operational workflows.
  • Interoperability Mindset: Strong understanding of how different systems exchange data, how interfaces are defined, and how interoperability is tested and validated.
  • Technical Communication: Ability to translate between operational users, engineering teams, software developers, RF specialists, suppliers, and program stakeholders.
  • Testing & Documentation: Experience supporting technical tests, integration trials, validation activities, or operational demonstrations, including structured documentation of results and findings.
  • Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify communication issues, integration gaps, configuration problems, and practical solutions.
  • Communication: Solid English skills are required. German skills for technical communication, stakeholder alignment, and documentation are a plus.
  • Team Fit: Ability to work collaboratively in a small, cross-functional team and communicate clearly and reliably in fast-moving engineering environments.
  • Clearance: Ability to obtain appropriate security clearance required for the position.

 

Nice-To-Have

 

  • Experience in defence, military communications, command-and-control systems, aerospace, naval systems, UAVs, or other mission-critical operational environments.
  • · Prior exposure to NATO communication standards, tactical networks, joint fires, air defence, command posts, or battlefield management systems.
  • · Experience with SATCOM terminals, tactical radios, MANET, IP-based tactical networks, or professional communication equipment.
  • · Experience integrating unmanned systems into wider military communication architectures.
  • · Understanding of network security, encryption concepts, authentication, routing, IP networking, and secure data exchange.

You work at the critical intersection of hardware and software: integrating EO/IR cameras, lidar, radar, and IMUs over their real interfaces, adapting the drivers and ROS2 nodes that capture them, solving time synchronization down to the microsecond, and calibrating multi-sensor rigs so every stream is spatially and temporally unified. And you don't just build in the lab: you regularly join our data-collection campaigns across Europe, deploying your systems under real conditions and making sure the data we bring home is worth training on.

Responsibilities

 

  • Own the end-to-end integration of our sensor suites — EO/IR cameras, gimbals, lidar, radar, IMU, GNSS — from electrical interfaces and wiring to working recording pipelines

  • Design and implement sensor drivers and ROS2 nodes, working directly with hardware protocols including I2C, SPI, CAN, Serial, MIPI/CSI-2, GigE Vision, and Ethernet (RTSP/UDP)

  • Solve temporal synchronization across distributed sensors (PTP, PPS, hardware triggering) so all streams are perfectly aligned for fusion and labeling

  • Develop and execute rigorous intrinsic and extrinsic calibration routines (camera-camera, camera-IMU) to spatially unify the sensor rigs

  • Build and optimize the onboard recording stack on embedded compute (NVIDIA Jetson): hardware-accelerated video pipelines (GStreamer), efficient logging (MCAP/rosbag), and storage throughput under compute, thermal, and bandwidth constraints

  • Evaluate new sensors hands-on at the bench — from probing electrical interfaces with diagnostic tools to benchmarking SDKs — and turn results into clear integration decisions

  • Join field data-collection campaigns across Europe: prepare and verify sensor setups, operate the recording systems on-site, diagnose hardware and software issues in real time, and validate recordings before leaving the site

  • Produce integration documentation and calibration reports so every setup is reproducible by the team

 

Required Skills

 

  • Degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or comparable practical experience

  • Proficiency in Python and C++ for robotics and hardware interfacing

  • Experience with ROS2, including deployment on physical systems

  • Hands-on experience with several hardware protocols such as I2C, SPI, CAN, Serial, or Ethernet-based sensor communication

  • Experience integrating cameras or other sensors on embedded Linux platforms, ideally NVIDIA Jetson

  • Solid computer vision fundamentals: camera models, distortion, projection geometry, OpenCV

  • Good understanding of coordinate frames, transformations, and time synchronization in distributed systems — practical calibration experience is a strong plus

  • Comfortable with hardware diagnostic tools (multimeter, oscilloscope) as well as modern software workflows (Git, CI, Docker)

  • Practical and structured; willingness to travel regularly for field campaigns and to work outdoors in various conditions

 

Nice-To-Have

 

  • UAV or mobile robot experience; PX4/ArduPilot and MAVLink basics

  • Photogrammetry + 3D Reconstruction

  • Low-level driver development or customization on embedded Linux

  • GStreamer hardware-accelerated pipelines, JetPack/L4T, CUDA/TensorRT

  • MIPI/CSI-2 camera bring-up, ISP tuning, or Linux kernel/device tree exposure

  • Calibration tooling such as Kalibr; lidar and point cloud processing (PCL, Open3D)

  • Experience with detection/tracking models and modern CV pipelines (PyTorch, ONNX)

  • Experience with simulation (Gazebo, Isaac Sim) or synthetic data generation

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Mission Brief

As a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in building and evolving the Software Platform capabilities used across Ground Systems. You will enable engineering teams with scalable, secure, and efficient development workflows while continuously improving developer productivity and software delivery. 

Specifically, this is a hands-on platform engineering role with a strong infrastructure core. Your mission is to own the runtime that Ground Systems software runs on both the on-premise Kubernetes clusters and the cloud services around them and the developer experience of getting software onto it. You will design cluster architecture, build the automation that provisions and maintains clusters across environments, and maintain the reusable delivery platform (GitLab CI/CD library, container toolchains, Helm charts, IaC modules) that product teams consume. 
 
Your role in our Space Mission...

  • Own and continuously evolve software platform capabilities enabling secure, reliable, and efficient software delivery 
  • Design and evolve the architecture of on-premise and cloud-hosted Kubernetes clusters and the surrounding platform: control-plane/worker topology, networking, storage, secrets management, and multi-environment promotion models. 
  • Make and document architecture decisions as ADRs and standards that other teams build against, balancing reliability, operability, cost, and delivery speed. 
  • Build and maintain automation that initialize, upgrades, and recovers clusters end to end as well as certificate lifecycle, node drains and upgrades, storage provisioning and incident management.

  • Manage workloads with Helm: author, version, and maintain charts for application services and stateful components (Kafka, ClickHouse, MQTT brokers, MSSQL), with automated semVer releases driven from merge requests.

What you’ll do

The PMD Recruiting Director - EMEA is a new, highly visible, and critical role on AlixPartners’ Executive Recruiting team. Reporting to the Global Head, Executive Recruiting, you will lead the executive recruiting team and function in EMEA, covering the UK, DACH, Italy, France, and the Middle East, focused on Partner (non-equity) and Partner & Managing Director (equity) candidates. You will set the strategy for this dynamic function, create trust-based executive stakeholder relationships, implement best practices, mentor and develop the team, and personally manage multiple searches and candidate relationships.

An important focus of this role is building trusted relationships with the highly matrixed EMEA leadership team, including regional and country leaders, and heads of Practices, Industries, and Service Lines. In addition, this role will often work with global leaders in the Americas and APAC. Strong communication skills, coupled with first-hand knowledge of local or country employment laws and customs, are very important.

You will create strong connections with candidates, helping guide them through a rigorous process with care and excellent communication. Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

About the Role

As Director of Operations, UK you will help build and lead the field operations team that installs and maintains Focal Systems shelf cameras across our UK retail partners. Our cameras are being deployed at scale, with 100,000+ units live or rolling out at leading retailers around the world, and the UK is a major part of that growth.

You will support the running of UK operations end to end: the people, the processes, the metrics, and the customer outcomes. You will work closely with senior and executive leadership to set and roll out operational strategy, and with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to make every deployment faster, more reliable, and more cost-effective than the last.

You will be joining an established, experienced team that works in cycles. Retailer rollouts bring periods of rapid scale-up, followed by quieter maintenance periods where we scale back down, and those transitions have not always been smooth. A key part of this role is making them smoother: planning ahead for each change in pace, keeping the team steady and supported through it, and building processes that let us ramp up and down without losing quality or momentum.

This is a senior leadership role. You will develop our existing team, support during scale-up and scale-down periods, set the operating rhythm for field work, and be the person our customers and colleagues rely on when something needs to get done.

What We Are Looking For

title: Human Resource Director, Europe & Canada
description:
Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. With a global team of over 3,000 professionals, we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to grow. Our mission is to securely connect people, places, and information with end-to-end technology solutions at scale.

At New Era, you'll join a team-oriented culture that prioritizes your personal and professional development. Work alongside industry-certified experts, access continuous training, and enjoy competitive benefits. Guided by our core attributes — putting people first, embracing continuous learning, and thriving through collaboration and inclusion — we nurture our people to deliver exceptional customer service.

If you want to make an impact in a supportive, growth-oriented environment, New Era is the place for you. Apply today and help us shape the future of work—together

 

The Human Resources Director, Europe & Canada is responsible for leading the HR strategy, operations, and employee experience across Canada, the United Kingdom, Belgium, and Romania. This position serves as the senior HR leader for the region and partners closely with business leaders to align people strategies with organizational priorities, business growth, and operational objectives.

Reporting directly to the Chief Human Resources Officer in the United States, the HR Director will provide leadership across employee relations, talent acquisition, organizational design, workforce planning, talent and leadership development, succession planning, payroll oversight, employment compliance, and general HR operations.

The successful candidate will bring strong experience operating in a complex, multi-country environment and will balance strategic leadership with effective day-to-day HR execution. The role will lead regional HR resources while collaborating closely with global HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and business leadership.

This Human Resources Director, Europe & Canada will have 3 direct reports and serves approximately 250 employees in the region. 

PRIMARY DUTIES:

Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Serve as the senior HR leader for Canada, the UK, Belgium, and Romania, providing strategic HR direction across the region. Other countries with small numbers of staff include France, Ireland, and the Netherlands.
  • Partner with EOR vendors for employment needs in countries outside of the company’s operations.
  • Partner with senior leaders and managers to translate business priorities into people strategies that drive growth, engagement, and performance.
  • Use workforce data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and adapt global HR initiatives to country-specific needs.

HR Operations & Regional Leadership

  • Lead regional HR operations, ensuring consistent, scalable, and employee-focused HR practices across the employee lifecycle.
  • Lead and develop the regional HR team, including HR Managers in the UK and Romania and an HR Coordinator in Romania.
  • Partner with global HR to standardize and continuously improve processes while addressing local requirements.

Employee Relations

  • Lead employee relations matters across the region, including disciplinary actions, grievances, investigations, redundancies, and dismissals.
  • Coach managers to address employee relations and performance issues consistently, with appropriate documentation and escalation.
  • Partner with General Counsel and external counsel on employment-related claims and proactively reduce employment risk.

Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Own regional recruitment and onboarding of top talent in partnership with offshore recruiters and hiring managers.
  • Build talent pipelines for critical roles and ensure hiring practices and documentation meet local requirements.

Talent Development, Succession & Career Planning

  • Lead employee development, succession planning, career pathing, and leadership development across the region.
  • Facilitate talent reviews with leaders to identify critical roles, high-potential employees, and capability gaps.

Payroll & HR Administration

  • Oversee regional payroll administration in partnership with the offshore payroll specialist team.
  • Maintain strong controls and coordination between HR, Payroll, and Finance for accurate employee transactions.

Employment Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure HR practices comply with employment requirements in Canada, the UK, Belgium, and Romania.
  • Monitor legislative developments and recommend updates to policies, documentation, and manager practices.
  • Support compliance for working time, leave, employee consultation, restructurings, redundancies, and terminations.

Organizational Effectiveness & Workforce Planning

  • Provide guidance on organizational structure, spans of control, and workforce planning to support growth and scalability.
  • Support integrations, restructurings, acquisitions, and related change and communication strategies within the region.

 

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • Significant progressive HR leadership experience, including experience at the HR Director, Head of HR, Senior HR Business Partner, or comparable level.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting employees and leaders across multiple countries or jurisdictions.
  • Strong working knowledge of employment practices and employee relations within the UK and broader European environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex employee relations matters, including investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, redundancies, and dismissals.
  • Experience partnering with senior business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, restructuring, and talent strategy.
  • Experience leading and developing HR professionals.
  • Strong understanding of recruitment, onboarding, performance management, succession planning and employee development.
  • Experience providing oversight or governance for payroll and HR operational processes.
  • Strong judgment and demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee matters.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, consultation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively within a global organization and collaborate across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Preferred

  • Direct HR experience supporting employees in Canada, the United Kingdom, Belgium, and/or Romania.
  • Experience within a global professional services, technology services, managed services, or similarly complex organization.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions, integrations, restructurings, or other large-scale organizational transformation.
  • Experience working within a global HR operating model that uses shared-services or offshore recruiting, payroll, or HR operations teams.

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:

  • Strategic Business Partnership: Connects workforce and organizational decisions directly to business priorities and outcomes.
  • Commercial Acumen: Understands how talent, organizational structure, workforce costs, and leadership capability affect business performance.
  • Employment Risk Judgment: Balances employee experience, business objectives, consistency, and employment risk when advising leaders.
  • Influence & Credibility: Builds trusted relationships with senior executives, managers, employees, and global functional partners.
  • Change Leadership: Effectively leads organizations and employees through transformation, restructuring, integration, and growth.
  • Talent Mindset: Proactively develops internal talent and strengthens leadership pipelines and succession plans.
  • Operational Excellence: Creates consistent, scalable HR processes while recognizing when local requirements require different approaches.
  • Global & Cultural Awareness: Works effectively across countries and cultures and avoids applying a single-country approach to regional workforce matters.
  • Sound Judgment & Discretion: Demonstrates maturity and confidentiality when handling sensitive employee and legal matters.

 

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, understand, and interpret job-related documents, instructions, policies, and communications in English. Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, with employees, customers, vendors, and other business partners, as applicable to the position. Fluent English is required. Fluent or professional-level French language capability is preferred.

REQUIRED EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Preferred: CIPD or an equivalent internationally recognized HR credential.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Regular use of hands and fingers to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment, including repetitive motions such as typing, scrolling, and mouse use. Ability to communicate effectively and understand verbal communication in person, by telephone, and through video conferencing or other remote communication tools. Ability to view and read information on computer screens and printed materials, including the ability to adjust focus. The position requires prolonged periods of computer use and viewing a computer screen.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: Remote

EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK: This position generally operates during normal business hours; however, specific start and end times may vary based on business needs, workload, and job responsibilities. Occasional work outside of normal business hours may be required.

TRAVEL: Occasional trips to Belgium and Romania may be required.

title: Senior Software Engineer – C# / .NET
description:
About Threecolts

Threecolts is a software suite built for consumer brands, helping them recover revenue, operate more efficiently and grow across major retailers and marketplaces.
Our largest business, Margin Pro, helps brands recover money owed to them by retailers and marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart and Target by managing disputes on their behalf. Alongside this, we’re building and scaling newer products, including AI Operator and Retail 365, while continuing to grow our portfolio of subscription products across our customer base.

Who We Are 

We’re a global team of 340 people across 33 teams, having grown through 24 acquisitions. We operate with a flat structure, giving people real ownership and the ability to move quickly. AI is embedded in how we work across the business, helping us increase speed, improve quality and operate at scale.

🔥 Key Responsibilities

You’ll take ownership of features across Inventory Lab’s C# and .NET-based systems, delivering them from initial design through to production. You’ll design, develop, and maintain clean, scalable backend services, APIs, and application components using C# and the .NET ecosystem.

You’ll work with modern .NET technologies, including ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core, to build and maintain reliable, high-performance web applications and services. You’ll focus on writing maintainable, well-tested code that supports the product’s evolving requirements.

You’ll develop and maintain front-end features using Vue.js and TypeScript, building responsive, intuitive, and maintainable user interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs. You’ll take ownership of full-stack features end to end, from designing backend services and data models to implementing front-end components, managing application state, and ensuring a consistent user experience. You’ll collaborate with Product, QA, and DevOps to deliver reliable, performant features across the entire application stack.

You’ll operate independently within a defined scope, making sound technical decisions and balancing delivery speed with long-term quality. You’ll actively improve existing systems, debug production issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes.

You’ll contribute to technical discussions, help evolve architecture within your domain, and raise engineering standards through thoughtful code reviews. Collaboration is key: you’ll work closely with Product, QA, and DevOps to deliver features and improvements that provide meaningful value to Inventory Lab customers.

😊 About You

  • 6–8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and experience building production-grade applications.
  • Strong understanding of the .NET platform, including its runtime, libraries, and application development ecosystem.
  • Experience developing web applications and backend services using ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core.
  • Experience developing modern web applications using Vue.js or React, including component-based architecture and reusable components.
  • Experience building responsive, accessible user interfaces and integrating front-end applications with REST APIs, and maintaining backend services.
  • Solid understanding of system design, application architecture, and scalable software development patterns.
  • Experience working with SQL databases, relational data models, and query optimization.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure: AWS or Azure.
  • Experience debugging production systems, investigating root causes, and resolving issues independently.
  • Comfortable working with Git, code reviews, automated testing, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Ability to work effectively within an existing codebase and improve code quality without over-engineering.

💼 What we’re looking for

You have a strong ownership mindset and consistently deliver high-quality work. You make pragmatic technical decisions, understanding when to prioritize speed and when to invest in scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

You understand the practical application of C# and the .NET ecosystem, choosing appropriate frameworks and patterns to build reliable software. You’re comfortable working with existing systems, identifying opportunities for improvement, and delivering solutions that balance immediate business needs with long-term technical quality.

You thrive in a product-led environment and care about the customer impact of what you build. You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams, and look for ways to improve both the product and engineering processes.

In this role, you’ll support Inventory Lab, a product used by e-commerce sellers to manage inventory, listings, accounting, and operational workflows. The work will suit someone who enjoys solving practical product problems, improving system reliability, and building software that supports real customer use cases.

title: Senior Associate - Materials
description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

Strategy Associate, Materials & Circular Economy

Location: London preferred. Amsterdam also possible

Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to join our Materials & Circular Economy team. This role is suited to someone who combines strong strategic thinking with the intellectual curiosity to tackle complex sustainability challenges.

You will work on some of the most important questions facing companies, governments and wider society as they shift towards more circular and sustainable models. Projects can range from shaping corporate strategy and identifying new business opportunities to assessing value chains, developing policy recommendations and designing system-level interventions.

We are looking for someone who can bring the core toolkit and pace of a strong strategy consultant: structured problem-solving, analytical rigour, clear communication and sound judgement. Strategy consulting experience is one route to demonstrating this. We are equally interested in candidates from other demanding analytical environments who can show the same quality of thinking and ability to turn complexity into clear recommendations.

You will join small, senior-led project teams and take meaningful responsibility from the outset. You will structure problems, conduct analysis, develop insights and work directly with clients to translate those insights into practical strategic choices.

Responsibilities

You will:

  • Structure complex problems: break ambiguous questions into clear workstreams, hypotheses and analytical priorities.

  • Generate insights: conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis, drawing conclusions from incomplete or complex information.

  • Shape recommendations: translate analysis into clear, concise and practical strategic recommendations.

  • Develop client materials: produce high-quality presentations, briefings and other client-ready outputs.

  • Engage with clients: work directly with senior stakeholders across businesses, governments, foundations and non-governmental organisations.

  • Contribute to project direction: help shape project approaches, hypotheses and emerging strategic conclusions.

  • Build trusted relationships: work effectively with clients, partners and stakeholders across multi-organisation initiatives.

About the team

You will be part of Systemiq's Materials & Circular Economy platform, led by Partner Ben Dixon.

Ben works across circular economy and energy topics and has advised organisations including the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, the United Nations International Resource Panel and multinational companies across packaging, chemicals and related sectors. He also leads Systemiq's work on plastics, focused on accelerating the transition towards a more circular and resource-efficient plastics system.

What we are looking for

Strategy and analytical capability

We are looking for candidates who already demonstrate, or can quickly operate with, the core toolkit expected in strategy consulting. You should be able to:

  • Structure complex and ambiguous problems into clear components, hypotheses and analytical questions.

  • Apply strong analytical judgement to qualitative and quantitative information.

  • Synthesize complex material into concise insights and decision-relevant recommendations.

  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including through high-quality presentation materials.

  • Work effectively at pace, managing changing priorities and imperfect information.

  • Move comfortably between detailed analysis and the broader strategic question.

Experience and background

You will typically bring:

  • At least two years of experience in strategy consulting, advisory or another analytically demanding environment.

  • Evidence of strong performance and increasing responsibility in your previous roles.

  • Experience contributing to strategy, investment, commercial or other decision-focused work.

  • Strong academic achievement, typically including a Master's degree or equivalent experience.

We particularly welcome candidates from strategy consulting, but relevant experience could also come from corporate strategy, investing, high-growth businesses, specialist advisory firms or other project-based environments where structured thinking and analytical rigour are central to the role.

Sector interest and understanding

You do not need to be a specialist across every part of the Materials & Circular Economy agenda. You should, however, bring:

  • An understanding of, or demonstrated ability to learn, complex industrial and consumer value chains.

  • Exposure to sectors such as plastics, petrochemicals, chemicals, consumer goods, manufacturing, mobility, energy or waste management.

  • A strong interest in sustainability, circular economy and the economic and strategic questions involved in system change.

Location

London is the preferred location for this role. We would also consider Amsterdam for candidates whose experience and capabilities are an especially strong match for the position.

Diversity & Inclusion
At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.

title: Software Engineer, Backend
description:
About the team

Restaurants run on a stack of tools that rarely talk to each other: one for delivery, another for online orders, another for reservations, another for loyalty, and a till that knows nothing about any of them. The same guest can look like three different customers across three different systems.

DashOS is DoorDash's platform for fixing that. It connects marketplace ordering, direct ordering, reservations, loyalty, guest management, marketing and point of sale around one shared view of the guest, so every product gets smarter as the others are used. DoorDash launched DashOS publicly at Dash Forward in September 2026, and from 2027 more than 80,000 restaurants on leading POS and middleware partners.

DashOS Engineering brings together engineers from across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt into one global organisation, led from London. Our teams cover reservations and guest CRM, digital ordering and omnichannel loyalty, POS and self-order kiosks, AI-powered marketing and Voice AI, and the shared data and integration platforms that connect them. Each team owns its own roadmap. The shared mission is making them work as one system.

About the role

We're looking for a backend-focused Software Engineer to build the high-performance, highly available services that restaurants depend on every day, from booking a table on a Friday night to recognising a regular the moment they order. You'll work closely with other engineers, product managers and designers, and because DashOS is newly launched, you'll help shape how its products connect rather than inheriting decisions someone else already made.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Design, build, test, deploy and improve backend services for customer-facing features used by restaurants and their guests in markets around the world.
  • Own features end to end, from technical design through to launch and ongoing support, including taking part in an on-call rotation to keep systems reliable.
  • Work on hard problems in data, latency and scale: unifying guest identity across channels, real-time availability search across thousands of venues, and integrations with the systems restaurants already run.
  • Build on DoorDash's global platform, so the features you ship can reach restaurants across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt markets rather than being rebuilt for each one.
  • Work in a modern engineering environment with frequent daily releases, feature flags and AI coding agents used across code review, deployment and debugging.
  • Partner with engineers, product managers and designers across London and other DashOS locations to decide what to build and how.

We're excited about you because...

  • You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, and a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • You've built and operated backend services or web applications in production, with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and system design.
  • You're fluent in at least one modern backend language (we mostly use Python), and you're happy to pick up new languages and tools as the platform evolves.
  • You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership of technical solutions from first design to production.
  • You use AI coding tools as part of how you work, or you're keen to, and you're comfortable reviewing and taking responsibility for what they produce.
  • You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve problems that don't have an obvious answer yet.

Tech you'll work with

Our services are built mainly in Python, with performance-critical systems in Rust, running on Google Cloud and DoorDash's global platform. AI coding agents are part of how we design, review and ship code, so we care more about how you solve problems than about which languages you've used before. You won't need to know every part of the stack on day one.

Where and how we work

This role is based in our London office at The River Building, on a hybrid pattern of 3 days a week in the office.

About SevenRooms

In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.

With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.

In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.

As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.

description:
About the job

Build the framework support that helps AI developers unlock Graphcore hardware.

You will help Graphcore accelerators work seamlessly with state-of-the-art ML frameworks, including Triton and PyTorch. Reporting to a Team Lead in Frameworks, you will design, implement, optimise and support critical software.

Your work will shape how researchers and engineers use Graphcore hardware for demanding machine learning workloads. You will improve performance, quality and usability across a complex software stack.

You will join our Triton team, delivering new features, reviewing code, writing technical documentation and working with upstream communities. You will also help coordinate open-ended technical work across teams.

This role offers deep technical ownership and visible impact as the ML software landscape evolves. You will keep learning and may contribute across other framework teams.

The team and culture

The Frameworks team connects Graphcore hardware with the tools ML engineers and researchers rely on. We work across PyTorch, Triton, JAX and TensorFlow, focusing on usability and performance.

Work happens through agile practices, close technical discussion and clear ownership. Engineers are trusted to speak up, solve hard problems and move work forward with pace.

Decisions are shaped by evidence, code quality and business outcomes. You will work across Graphcore and with open-source communities to deliver software developers can trust.

What we’re looking for

· Strong software engineering skills, with the judgement to manage quality, complexity and technical debt.
· Experience developing in Python and C++.
· Experience in compiler development.
· Ability to manage complex technical tasks with cross-team dependencies.
· Clear communication skills, with a proactive approach to collaboration and technical leadership.
· Interest in AI, ML frameworks, performance optimisation or computationally intensive engineering.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

If you want to shape the frameworks developers use to push AI compute forward, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to be part of the journey.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Engineer

Location: Bristol, London or Edinburgh (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Senior Engineer II (TL1)

Team: Engineering

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager

 

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

You’ll join a technology community of product-focused and data-led product and platform engineers working at scale. We have a diverse ecosystem, spanning TypeScript on AWS, Go on GCP and Scala, we index on product-minded problem solving over language purity.

As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from design through to production, and you’ll build AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.

From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and access to the systems you need through MCP. Our tools and conventions evolve quickly, and you’ll directly impact how we build from here.

 

  • Own a slice of the product end to end: shape the problem with product and design, build the interface and the services behind it, ship it, and run it in production.
  • Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.
  • Build with AI coding agents as your default: Break work down so agents can execute, direct them, and review their output as carefully as you’d review a colleague’s pull request. You’ll also maintain the tests and safeguards that let agent written code merge safely.
  • Stay close to the people who use what you build: directly or through our forward-deployed engineers: a supplier’s operations team, a customer plugging in a car at night. Instrument what you ship so you can see how it’s used, and turn what you learn into shipped changes.
  • Make good work the default: shape the codebase, conventions and automated checks so that agents and new teammates produce the right thing without anyone catching it in review.
  • Mentor the team around you: Coach and mentor your peers and help improve how we work and evolve as a team. 

 

What you’ll bring

 

These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our top engineers and value deeply, but we don't expect everyone to tick every single box. If you're excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Experience shipping production software: You have a depth of experience in either a front-end or back-end of a modern stack, and potentially an openness to stretch across both as you navigate our diverse ecosystem.
  • AI coding tools: You build with tools like Cursor or Claude Code, can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way and review AI output as rigorously as a colleague’s pull request.
  • Able to navigate a complex, high-stakes domain: You keep complex energy logic legible across microservices, knowing exactly when to use sync vs async to prevent cascading failures.
  • Cloud and operational ownership: You're comfortable deploying on major cloud platforms using shared tooling. You fully own your software in production, which includes participating in an out-of-hours on-call rota.
  • Strong product sense. You ask the “why” before building, and you can describe a time when user feedback or metrics changed what you shipped.
  • Clear written communication. You write specs, pull request descriptions and post-mortems with enough clarity and context that either a human teammate or an AI agent can immediately act on them.
  • A multiplier for your team: You mentor peers and proactively shape how the team works; introducing conventions, checks or shared context that makes everyone else’s output consistently better.

It would be great if you have

  • Experience building tooling around coding agents, such as MCP servers, skills or CI checks
  • Experience in energy, or another real-time or regulated field

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.
  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.
  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.
  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period
  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests
  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% of salary to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work
  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget
  • Climate: Access to Furthr, our climate action app

 

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.
