title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description: Let’s transform banking forever ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate. That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure. But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward. What you can expect: As our Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you’ll play an important role in creating a seamless and welcoming experience for candidates and keeping our Talent Acquisition operations running smoothly. You’ll coordinate interviews, maintain accurate information in Ashby and support the production of regular Talent Acquisition reporting. You’ll also work with colleagues across Talent to support supplier administration and help organise our monthly induction for new joiners. This role is suited to someone who enjoys bringing structure to a busy environment, cares about getting the details right and wants every interaction with ClearBank to leave a positive impression. Your role includes: Complete the day-to-day administration of Ashby, maintaining accurate and complete candidate, vacancy and recruitment information to support reliable reporting and compliant hiring processes. Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, managing candidate and interviewer communication and availability to create a timely, organised and professional experience. Welcome and support candidates attending interviews at the ClearBank office, particularly senior candidates, creating a positive and professional first impression. Monitor recruitment activity and data quality in Ashby, identifying missing, inaccurate or outdated information and working with recruiters to resolve issues promptly. Produce accurate weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards and insights, providing clear visibility of recruitment activity and data to the Talent Acquisition Lead. Support wider Talent operations, including supplier onboarding and offboarding for the Head of Talent and the organisation of monthly new-joiner induction with the Talent Development Manager. Identify opportunities to improve Talent Acquisition coordination and administration, suggesting practical ways to make processes simpler, clearer and more effective. What does success in this role look like: Ashby contains accurate, complete and dependable recruitment information that the Talent Acquisition team can confidently use for reporting and decision-making. Candidates experience organised, timely and thoughtful communication throughout interview coordination and when visiting the ClearBank office. Interviews are coordinated effectively across stakeholders and time zones, with scheduling problems identified and resolved promptly. Weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards are produced accurately and consistently, giving the Talent Acquisition Lead clear visibility of recruitment activity. Supplier administration and monthly induction coordination are organised and reliable, with the relevant stakeholders kept informed. What you’ll bring: To excel in this role, you’ll also need: Previous experience in a Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination or similar role, with hands-on experience supporting interview scheduling, candidate administration and day-to-day recruitment processes. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple interviews, activities and competing priorities. Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with recruitment systems, schedules, reports and confidential information. Confidence communicating with candidates and colleagues at different levels of seniority. The ability to use digital systems effectively and learn new technology and processes quickly. A methodical approach to maintaining accurate records and identifying missing or inconsistent information. The ability to take ownership of assigned tasks, follow agreed processes and ask for support when needed. A little bit more about us! ClearBank is Where You Can belong: At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 42% of our senior management roles are held by women Our enhanced family leave policies Launching our partnership with Code First Girls Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group Our hiring process and what you can expect: Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). title: Partner Engagements Manager, Compliance Strategy
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the role The Partner Engagements Manager, Compliance Strategy will lead Checkout’s external-facing compliance strategy across banking, scheme and other strategic partner relationships. You will own the operating model and delivery of compliance-related partner engagements, including annual reviews, periodic due diligence, requests for information, licensing and scheme initiatives, and readiness for product or geographic expansion. You will ensure that Checkout presents a consistent, accurate and well-evidenced view of its compliance framework, while converting external expectations into practical improvements to our roadmap, controls, processes and operating model. The role combines strategic ownership, senior stakeholder management and hands-on delivery. You will lead complex engagements, advise Compliance leadership, build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and develop the partner-engagement capability of the team, including managing and coaching Senior Analyst(s) as the structure is established. What you will do Own the Compliance Strategy partner-engagement portfolio, prioritising work across banking partners, schemes and other strategic external stakeholders. Establish and continuously improve the operating model for partner engagements, including governance, roles and responsibilities, service standards, evidence expectations, response libraries, escalation routes and management information. Lead annual KYC AML partner compliance reviews, partner onboarding or refreshes, complex RFIs and other material external engagements from planning through to closure. Act as a senior Compliance representative in partner meetings, with high level input around Checkout’s compliance framework, risk management approach, policies, controls, governance and improvement plans with clarity and confidence. Provide oversight and challenge to response packs, control narratives, policy summaries, presentations and supporting evidence, ensuring consistency, accuracy and appropriate ownership. Lead compliance support for scheme, product-launch and geographic-expansion initiatives, ensuring external partner obligations and readiness requirements are identified, tracked and addressed. Translate partner feedback, requests and emerging expectations into strategic recommendations, roadmap priorities, control enhancements and process improvements. Build strong working relationships across Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, Commercial, Finance, Technology and regional teams to align delivery and resolve dependencies. Maintain clear governance over engagement risks, issues, decisions, action plans and remediation, escalating material matters to the Head of Compliance Strategy and relevant governance forums. Produce concise and decision-useful updates for Compliance leadership, senior management and governance committees, including themes, trends, risks, commitments and delivery status. Partner with relevant second-line teams to ensure external engagement activity is consistent with the Compliance framework, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and the responsibilities of the three lines of defence. Coach, develop and set clear expectations for Senior Analyst(s). Create and implement a high-quality, scalable and collaborative partner-engagement framework. Identify opportunities to use better data, tooling, workflow design and documentation to improve response quality, reduce duplication and increase the resilience of the Compliance operating model. Represent Compliance Strategy in cross-functional strategic initiatives and take on other priorities that support long-term capability maturation. What you will need to be successful Typically 3–5 years of experience in a similar role within compliance, regulatory compliance, risk, audit, legal or a related function in payments, fintech, banking or another regulated financial-services environment. Demonstrable experience leading external partner, banking, scheme, audit, regulatory or due-diligence engagements. Experience translating regulatory or partner expectations into practical requirements, delivery plans, governance and measurable improvements. Experience leading complex, cross-functional workstreams with multiple stakeholders, dependencies and deadlines. Experience coaching or managing people, setting priorities, giving feedback and creating clarity in a fast-moving environment. Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem and the compliance expectations relevant to banking partners, payment schemes and regulated financial institutions. Working knowledge of relevant compliance domains such as AML/CTF, sanctions, KYC/CDD/EDD, licensing, safeguarding, operational resilience, regulatory change or control assurance. Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present complex issues, defend recommendations and influence senior stakeholders. Strong judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively, distinguish material from non-material issues and escalate appropriately. Strong organisational, analytical and project-management skills, with a track record of delivering high-quality outcomes under pressure. ICA, ACAMS or another relevant professional qualification is desirable. How you will work at Checkout Be The Owner: Set direction, create accountability and ensure commitments are delivered. Talk Straight: Give clear, evidence-led advice and communicate difficult messages respectfully and early. One Team: Build alignment across functions and regions, sharing context and bringing people with you. No Room for Approximation: Set a high bar for accuracy, evidence, consistency and regulatory defensibility. Athlete Mindset: Plan rigorously, raise the standard and keep improving the capability of the function. Better Every Day: Turn recurring engagement friction into scalable processes, tools and operating-model improvements. Pace Matters: Balance urgency with thoughtful risk judgement and disciplined execution. Fundamentally Positive: Lead with trust, humility and a practical, solution-oriented approach. What success looks like Partner engagement framework is clearly documented with detailed SLAs and communicated to all relevant stakeholders. Partner engagements are planned, governed and delivered consistently across the portfolio. Checkout is represented externally through clear, accurate, credible and coherent compliance narratives. Material risks, gaps and commitments are visible to the right stakeholders and managed through to resolution. Scheme, product and geographic-expansion initiatives receive timely and practical Compliance Strategy support. Partner feedback is converted into measurable improvements in processes, documentation, monitoring, tooling and capability. The Senior Analyst(s) and wider stakeholder network have clear priorities, effective ways of working and opportunities to grow. Compliance leadership has reliable management information to understand engagement themes, risks, capacity and progress. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. title: Senior Account Executive
description:
About the Role  

Ogilvy Health is looking for a highly organised and proactive Senior Account Executive to join our Medical Communications team.

This role will sit within a high-profile global neurology and immunology account, supporting the delivery of scientifically robust, strategically aligned programmes that help improve outcomes for patients and healthcare professionals worldwide.

As a Senior Account Executive, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring projects are delivered efficiently, on time and to the highest standard. You will work closely with clients, scientific colleagues, healthcare professionals and cross-functional agency teams, taking ownership of project delivery while developing your strategic, scientific and client management expertise.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious medical communications professional looking to accelerate their career as part of a collaborative, scientifically driven and creatively focused team.

What You’ll Do 

  • Support the day-to-day delivery of a global neurology and immunology account, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget and to the highest standard.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, healthcare professionals and internal teams, becoming a trusted and reliable partner.
  • Coordinate a wide range of medical communications activities, from publications and medical education programmes to congresses, advisory boards and events.
  • Work closely with scientific, creative and digital colleagues to bring complex science to life in meaningful ways.
  • Take ownership of project plans, timelines and budgets, proactively managing priorities and keeping programmes moving forward.
  • Develop your therapy area expertise and contribute to strategic discussions that help shape client programmes.
  • Support and mentor junior team members while continuing to grow your own medical communications career.

What You’ll Need  

  • Experience working within a medical communications, healthcare communications or healthcare agency environment.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • A keen interest in science, healthcare and the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Confidence working with cross-functional teams and a range of stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of budgets and project delivery.
  • A collaborative approach and a desire to learn and develop within a fast-paced agency environment.

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.  

Benefits

  • Take advantage of season ticket loans, cycle-to-work scheme, property rental assistance, and generous employee discounts. 

 

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. title: AI - Enabled Software Engineer
description:
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the country in which the role is being hired. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Mark43’s mission is to empower communities and their governments with new technologies that improve the safety and quality of life for all. We build powerful, scalable, and elegant software that sets a new standard for the tools upon which our first responders rely. Our users are diverse, and we are therefore committed to embracing diversity of thought and experience within our team. 

Our platform is already trusted by major public safety agencies across North America—including Boston, D.C., Seattle, and the California Highway Patrol—and we’ve expanded into the UK. 

Now, we’re entering an exciting new chapter: Mark43 is building a next-generation AI-augmented engineering team. This is a foundational opportunity to help rethink how software is designed, developed, and delivered using intelligent agentic or related tools. 

What You’ll Do 

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help lead our AI-enabled engineering initiative. You’ll work at the frontier of AI and software development, experimenting with agentic workflows and shaping how AI tools are integrated into every layer of our engineering stack. 

This isn’t just about using AI to autocomplete code—it’s about designing and orchestrating systems of AI agents that can plan, write, review, test, and deploy software collaboratively. In essence, you’ll play a role akin to a tech lead for a team of intelligent coding agents. 

You will: 

  • Design multi-agent systems with coding-focused agents (e.g., code writer, reviewer, tester, deployer) 
  • Write the prompts, logic, and scaffolding that guide each agent’s behavior 
  • Handle tool use, like enabling agents to access the file system, test runners, version control, and internal APIs 
  • Evaluate and refine agents’ output, performance, collaboration patterns, and feedback loops 

If you were on the team last week, you might have: 

  • Prototyped a new coding assistant workflow using open-source LLMs and internal knowledge bases 
  • Led an architecture discussion on agentic build pipelines or automated PR generation 
  • Collaborated with a cross-functional team to build a fast, AI-powered interface for internal tooling 
  • Helped define the evaluation framework for AI contributions—accuracy, speed, and impact 
  • Mentored a teammate on combining TypeScript and AI tools to accelerate UI prototyping 
  • Explored best practices for safely and securely integrating generative AI into a public sector codebase 
  • Participated in our on call rotation 

 

What You’ll Need 

We’re looking for an experienced software engineer who is eager to build smarter systems by pairing technical expertise with emerging AI tools. You don’t need to be an AI researcher—but you do need hands-on experience applying generative AI tools to real-world development workflows. 

You should have: 

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience 
  • Proficiency with at least part of our stack: Java, TypeScript + React, and MySQL 
  • Extensive applied experience with AI-assisted development tooling—whether it’s Cursor, Windsurf, LLM APIs, codegen platforms, vector databases, agentic frameworks like LangChain, or custom-built systems 
  • A strong product mindset and interest in building for real-world impact 
  • A bias toward experimentation, iteration, and continuous learning 
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and helping define best practices in a rapidly evolving space 

We’re flexible on which tools you’ve used—we care more about your ability to learn, adapt, and creatively apply AI in practical settings than checking a specific tech box.  

People Who Thrive on Our Team Also Tend to Be: 

  • Humble, open, and curious. You ask questions and seek to understand before making assumptions 
  • Collaborative by default. You believe the best outcomes come from shared knowledge and ownership 
  • Mission-driven. You care about building tech that serves the public good 
  • Comfortable with uncertainty. You’re energized by open problems and emerging technologies 
  • Growth-oriented. You embrace feedback, learn from setbacks, and look for ways to get better every day 

 

 

Mark43 is approved to hire in Canada, the UK, and 36 U.S. states, including Alabama, Arizona, California (excluding San Francisco), Colorado, Connecticut, Washington D.C., Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Massachusetts, Maryland, Maine, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, North Carolina, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Vermont, Washington, Wisconsin, and West Virginia. State locations and specifics are subject to change as our hiring requirements shift.

As a part of Mark43's security measures all employees must: Engage in appropriate use of the company's electronic information resources; Become knowledgeable about and follow relevant security policies and guidelines; Protect the resources under their control, such as passwords, computers, and data that they create, receive, or download; and Promptly report security-related incidents and violations, and responding to official reports of security incidents involving their systems or accounts.

About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

We're looking for a strategic, analytical leader to drive growth and performance across our European and International business. In this role you'll personally own a high-impact portfolio of initiatives, doing the deep analytical work and driving execution yourself, while setting strategic direction and coaching a small team of individual contributors.

You’ll connect the dots across product and go-to-market, using analytics, customer insights, and opportunity sizing to decide where we invest and how we execute. You’ll partner closely with Product, Operations, Revenue, and Data Science, and become a trusted advisor to senior leadership across the business.

This is a player-coach role for someone who wants to shape strategy and also roll up their sleeves to deliver results. This role is based in London.

What you’ll do

  • Drive OKR attainment for the International team, owning strategy and execution for our Europe Top 8 priorities
  • Lead and develop a team of Strategy & Operations ICs through coaching, prioritization, and vision setting
  • Personally own key initiatives in Europe: identify opportunities that move company metrics, align cross-functional teams, remove roadblocks, and lead execution end to end
  • Prioritize GTM and Product initiatives based on impact, strategic importance, and complexity, and partner with Data Science to build and refine the models that support those decisions
  • Proactively identify opportunities that grow retailer lifetime value (LTV)
  • Drive forecasting, performance monitoring, and metric decomps, and surface the insights that matter most to leadership
  • Build effective, scalable operational processes and close operational gaps
  • Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Product, Operations, Revenue, and leadership

Qualifications

  • Experience managing and developing people

title: Managing Director - THG Studios
description:
About THG Ingenuity 

THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises: 

  • THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system. 
  • THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.  
  • THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel 

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce. 

Managing Director - THG Studios 

Reporting to: Group CEO 

About THG Studios 

THG Studios is an integrated creative and production agency helping ambitious brands create high-quality content, build stronger connections with their audiences and deliver measurable growth. 

Based in Manchester, we bring creative, production and technology together under one roof. Our work spans high-volume e-commerce content, social-first campaigns, brand platforms, immersive experiences and technology-led activations. 

We work with a broad range of well-known brands, including Disney, L’Oréal, Myprotein, LOOKFANTASTIC, ASDA, Sky Vegas, Warner Bros., Jet2, Swizzels, Avolta and The Overlap. 

As THG Studios continues to grow, we are looking for an ambitious and commercially focused Managing Director to lead the agency and build on its strong creative, production and technology capabilities. 

The Role 

The Managing Director will set the strategic direction for THG Studios and take overall accountability for its growth, commercial performance and market position. 

With full P&L ownership, you will be responsible for delivering sustainable revenue and profit growth, developing the agency’s proposition and identifying new opportunities across existing clients, new business and strategic partnerships. 

You will lead and support the senior leadership team, including the Group Creative Director, General Managers and Client Partners. You will also play an active role in senior client relationships, major pitches, strategic opportunities and escalated matters. 

This role requires a proven leader from the creative, production, content or agency sector who understands how to grow a successful business. You will need to combine commercial focus with creative ambition, strong operational discipline and the ability to build a high-performing team. 

Key Responsibilities 

Strategy and growth 

  • Set the strategic direction for THG Studios and lead the delivery of its growth plan. 
  • Identify new markets, sectors, services, partnerships and revenue opportunities. 
  • Develop and strengthen THG Studios’ agency proposition and competitive position. 
  • Build on the agency’s existing capabilities to increase its value to clients and unlock new commercial opportunities. 
  • Ensure growth plans are focused, measurable and aligned with the businesses wider objectives. 

Commercial and P&L ownership 

  • Take full ownership of the THG Studios P&L and deliver agreed revenue and profit targets. 
  • Drive sustainable growth across existing client accounts, new business and strategic partnerships. 
  • Ensure strong commercial discipline across pricing, margins, forecasting and client profitability. 
  • Make informed decisions about investment in people, technology and capabilities to support growth. 
  • Monitor commercial performance and take action where performance is not on track. 

Client leadership and new business 

  • Be ultimately accountable for client retention, account growth and new business performance. 
  • Lead and support the Client Partners and Business Development team, who will manage day-to-day client and new business activity. 
  • Maintain senior relationships with key clients and become involved in strategic accounts, major opportunities and escalated matters. 
  • Support or lead significant pitches, tenders, negotiations and partnership opportunities. 
  • Ensure the agency is consistently identifying opportunities to increase its share of client spend. 

Leadership and market position 

  • Set clear strategic priorities, accountabilities and measures of success across the agency.

title: Sector Lead (Telecommunications Media Technology) Directed Content
description:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About Expert Insights:
Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,  delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.

About the Team:

The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.

About the Role: 

As a Sector Lead on our TMT (Technology, Media and Telecoms) Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. Reporting to the Director of Research (TMT) you will oversee the day-to-day execution of Directed Content projects, ensuring all work meets the firm’s standards for quality, relevance, and, end-user value delivery. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.

You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. Your responsibilities will span project setup, expert sourcing guidance, transcript quality assurance, budget oversight, and performance management. Acting as the connective layer between the Director of Research’s strategic vision and day-to-day execution, you will ensure flawless delivery of sector coverage plans while maintaining a pulse on emerging market themes and client information needs.

You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Partner with  the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will then translate into a structured execution plan, ensuring coverage aligns with key market and client priorities.
  • Manage and mentor a team of Project Managers that oversee the execution of Directed Content projects, setting clear goals, tracking KPIs, and ensuring accountability across all deliverables.
  • Collaborate with Operations Managers who oversee Analyst execution of expert recruiting, onboarding, and interaction facilitation to align operational KPIs to coverage strategy and optimize execution
  • Own expert budget management for your sector, allocating resources effectively to maximize content ROI while maintaining high quality and throughput.
  • Oversee a structured QA process for ensuring transcripts within your sector of coverage meet the highest standards for data accuracy, relevance, structure, and analytical depth.
  • Collaborate closely with the Director of Research and our Content Strategy Analyst to monitor engagement data, identify coverage gaps, and recalibrate project pipelines accordingly.
  • Collaborate closely with the Director of Research to identify and shape content to support revenue-generating efforts such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.
  • Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future content.
  • Collaborate with North America directed content teams to ensure high quality output and consistency.
  • Partner with Operations and Product teams to pilot and optimize AI-enabled tools that improve project throughput, QA precision, and overall efficiency.
  • Maintain deep familiarity with ongoing developments within the Healthcare, TMT or Energy & Industrial sectors, proactively surfacing new themes and companies to guide future research focus.

Who You Are:

  • You have 5–7 years of experience in equity research, market intelligence, consulting, or a related analytical role within TMT
  • You bring deep domain expertise in Technology, Media & Telecoms with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends shaping your space.
  • You have a strong understanding of European and Asian equity markets.
  • You have proven people management experience, successfully leading, mentoring, and developing teams of project managers or analysts.

description:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

 

Senior Content Designer needed to join our Design Team on a permanent basis.

 

The opportunity

We’re looking for a confident, creative and versatile Senior Content Designer to work on our client’s website experience.

As a Senior Content Designer, you’ll be shaping experiences that are rewarding, personalised and effortless in every interaction.

You’ll find new opportunities and improve existing journeys, crafting intuitive and engaging solutions for major product initiatives, multi-step journeys, campaign activity and vehicle launches.

You’ll weigh business objectives with user expectations, delivering content that exceeds both. And you’ll use language to engage, inform, guide and persuade.

So, you’ll really need to know the value the right content can add to a customer journey. Plus, you’ll need a big appetite for using customer research, data and analytics and smart uses of AI to guide your design process.

You’ll work mostly independently, with support from a Content Lead to provide direction, review your work and help navigate complex decisions.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own Major Initiatives & Launches: Drive the end-to-end content design for flagship launches, multi-step customer flows, and complex campaign-driven journeys across digital platforms.
  • Be the Content Advocate in Early Discovery: Partner early with product managers and UX leads in the concept phase, shaping product intent, defining information hierarchy, and solving UX problems with content before visuals are developed.
  • Architect Complex Journeys: Design and structure multi-step content architecture, taxonomy, and navigation paths to ensure seamless transitions across complex digital touchpoints.
  • Evolve the Content Design System: Define and document reusable content components, patterns, and copy standards within our design system to ensure long-term consistency across digital products.
  • Establish Governance Frameworks: Define clear content governance models, review processes, and quality frameworks so high standards and brand consistency are maintained post-launch.
  • Drive Data-Informed Decisions: Interrogate quantitative performance data (conversion, drop-off, engagement) and qualitative research to formulate hypotheses, test copy variations, and make evidence-based design iterations.
  • Foster Cross-Functional Alignment: Work autonomously with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and Legal to align journey messaging with product requirements.
  • Ensure Accessibility & Inclusivity: Ensure all multi-step flows and launch content comply with modern accessibility standards (WCAG), plain language requirements, and assistive technology needs.
  • Leverage Modern Tooling: Work hands-on in tools like Figma and FigJam to document user flows, wireframe content layouts, prototype copy in situ, and explore AI-assisted workflows to optimise efficiency.

 

What we want from you

  • Deep Content Design Experience: Proven track record designing content for complex digital products, multi-step journeys, or major customer-facing campaign launches.
  • Complex Journey & Architecture Skills: Demonstrated capability in content architecture, information hierarchy, and structuring complicated user flows into clear, intuitive journeys.
  • Early-Phase UX Advocacy: Experience collaborating with product and design partners at the problem-framing stage, shaping the solution before high-fidelity design work starts.
  • Design Systems & Governance Experience: Practical experience developing, documenting, or applying content design system components, style guidelines, and governance processes.
  • Strong Data Literacy: Comfortable using analytics, conversion metrics, and user research findings to steer content decisions and evaluate performance.
  • Cross-Discipline Alignment: Skilled at collaborating autonomously with stakeholders across product, marketing, and brand to align on goals and resolve conflicting priorities.
  • Figma & Prototyping: Hands-on experience working directly inside Figma and modern collaborative tools to prototype content alongside UX/UI designers.
  • Accessibility Expertise: A thorough working knowledge of digital accessibility, screen-reader compatibility, and inclusive language principles.
  • Relevant Background: A degree or equivalent hands-on experience in English, Communications, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), UX Design, or a related field. Proof of user-centred decisions, testing or iteration.

 

If you know some of this, even better

  • Experience working on major product rollouts or campaign launches within automotive, luxury, or high-volume e-commerce.
  • Specialist training or certifications in Information Architecture or Content Strategy.
  • Experience establishing content governance or editorial review workflows across large, multi-brand platforms.

 

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Permanent only
We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

 

How we use AI in the recruitment process: 
 
To ensure more focused and engaging conversations, we leverage AI in our recruitment process exclusively for secure, objective note-taking, never for evaluative judgments. This allows our team to be fully present with you. You are always welcome to request a transcript of these notes or opt out of this feature at any time. Opting out will not impact  the outcome of the interview process"

description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Wayve’s Robot Software group turns new vehicle programs into stable, reliable robot systems. The Platform Integration team works at the boundary between onboard software and vehicle hardware, bringing up new platforms while building reusable components and frameworks that make every future integration faster and more predictable. As a Software Engineer on the Platform Integration team, you’ll combine hands-on vehicle and bench work with production software development. Your work will directly enable safe, scalable deployment across multiple vehicle programs. 🧠 Your day-to-day Support software bring-up on benches, HiL systems, and vehicles, including work at international test locations. Develop and maintain vehicle-facing software components and shared frameworks. Diagnose integration issues across software and hardware boundaries and drive them through resolution. Identify architectural improvements that reduce bespoke work and improve reuse. Build diagnostics, tooling, and metrics for robot-software reliability and performance. Produce clear documentation and runbooks for long-term supportability. Collaborate with hardware, safety, controls, calibration, and reliability teams. 🧩 What you’ll be working on New vehicle-program bring-up across embedded compute, sensors, networks, and software services. Linux-based robotic and automotive systems with multi-process and distributed architectures. ROS2 or similar middleware, node development, message interfaces, and system integration. Sensor calibration, synchronisation, data validation, and system-level debugging. Automotive-grade compute platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE and Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride. Vehicle communication systems including CAN and Automotive Ethernet. Shared abstractions and frameworks that improve reliability across programs. 🙌 You should apply if You have strong software-development experience in C++, Python, or Rust. You have delivered production-quality software on Linux-based robotic, embedded, or automotive platforms. You understand ROS2 or similar robotics middleware and distributed-system integration. You have hands-on experience integrating software with vehicle or embedded hardware. You can diagnose complex problems using logs, telemetry, on-target tests, and systematic experimentation. You understand vehicle sensors, networking, and the practical realities of platform bring-up. Experience with drive-by-wire systems, CAN tools, shared frameworks, HiL or simulation, functional safety, technical documentation, or observability would be valuable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial recruiter screen — 25 mins Competency Interviews — Programming and technical domain (2 hours) Deep-dive technical interviews — Programming, software design, and hiring-manager/team fit (3 hours) Final interview — Mission and values alignment (30 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. title: Graduate Technology Strategy Analyst, Physical Sciences / Engineering (2027 start)
description:
Introduction

Are you a recent or soon-to-be graduate in chemistry, physics, engineering or a related field, excited to put your scientific knowledge and curiosity to work on real-world business issues? Are you interested in understanding why some scientific breakthroughs change the world, while other promising technologies struggle to make it into everyday life? Are you fascinated by how things are made, how people use them and how we can shape a more sustainable future?

Do you enjoy exploring complex questions, making connections between ideas and working with others to find thoughtful, practical solutions? Would you like to help businesses understand not just what technology can do, but how it can make a meaningful difference?
If so, this could be a great role for you!
 

Who we are

A key part of Cambridge Consultants, our Advisory team works with clients across Consumer, Energy & Industrial, Telecommunications, Biotech, Healthcare and Defence & Security. Our clients range from early start-ups to global organisations, all looking for ways to use emerging technologies to address challenges, create new possibilities and make a positive impact in their markets.
Our role is to help them navigate uncertainty, explore opportunities and turn promising ideas into practical outcomes.
We provide research and insights to support important business choices relating to deep tech. This includes go-to-market strategies, investment support, competitor analysis, market insights, technology road-mapping and strategic foresight. The technologies we explore span exciting developments in biotech, quantum sensing and computing, robotics and physical AI, among many others.
 

Your role

This role sits within the Research & Insights section of our Advisory group. We explore how emerging technologies and future trends might shape the choices businesses make today, helping our clients feel better equipped to navigate change and plan for the future.
You might investigate what people will value in the next generation of products, explore how cleantech can be adopted at scale, or uncover where novel sensors could create new possibilities for businesses and their customers.
It's an opportunity to combine scientific thinking, creative exploration and commercial understanding to help answer questions that don't always have straightforward answers.
 

What you will be doing

With guidance and support from our wider Advisory team, you will:
  • Explore a variety of meaningful projects spanning climate tech investment, new energy generation, smart mobility strategy and emerging deep tech fields such as quantum.
  • Bring fresh perspectives to complex challenges, drawing on different research approaches and ideas to help clients identify opportunities across products, services and operations, including AI-enabled approaches.
  • Work collaboratively with specialists in engineering, science, product design and realisation, and business to develop strategies that create commercial and societal benefits.
  • Make sense of complex information, analysing markets, technologies and business models to help clients understand their options, consider potential challenges and drive informed actions.
  • Share ideas and contribute to thought leadership on how deep tech could help address global challenges, from communication on the moon to the future of repairable consumer devices.

 

What you can bring

 
We are looking for applicants with the following traits and skills: 
  • A relevant academic background: A Master's or PhD in physical sciences, maths, data science, engineering or another related discipline.
  • Business and commercial thinking: Experience or an interest in entrepreneurship, business or economics, whether through student business plan competitions, internships, start-ups or relevant modules and further study.
  • Thoughtful analytical and creative thinking: The ability to explore complex technical ideas, recognise connections and turn findings into clear, practical recommendations.
  • Curiosity and adaptability: Enthusiasm for learning about new technologies, exploring different sectors and approaching unfamiliar challenges with an open mind.
  • Communication and collaboration: The ability to explain complex ideas clearly, listen to different perspectives and build constructive relationships with people from a range of technical and professional backgrounds.

 

How to apply

If this opportunity interests you, please send your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience, interests and what excites you about the role.
We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. You don't need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If the role sparks your curiosity and you'd enjoy exploring how science and technology can make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.

About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.

Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.

This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue. 

The Team

You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer. 

What you'll own

  • Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.
  • Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.
  • Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.
  • Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.
  • Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .

What we're looking for

  • A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.
  • Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.
  • Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.
  • Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.
  • Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.
  • Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.
  • Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.

Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.

How we'll measure success

Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.

We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.

We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.

Who will thrive here

Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.

You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.

This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.

We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.

#LI-RH1

title: Director of Product (Features) - Star Trek Fleet Command
description:
Scopely is looking for a Director of Product, Features to lead the features teams for Star Trek Fleet Command, based in London on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top 10 gross revenue Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You’ll Do

This individual will own the long-view strategic planning across the game’s Features ensuring alignment between strategic vision and tactical execution. Key responsibilities include:

  • Own the business performance of the Features function, accountable for delivering game KPIs and guiding decisions which drive sustainable long term growth.
  • Own every aspect of a roadmap that achieves KPI goals set by you and the Product Team. Guiding cross-functional partners such as game designers, UX designers and artists to deliver a product that meets the product’s vision and strategy
  • Formulate product strategy and create engaging game mechanics and core game loops
  • See feature development through from concept to launch, including post launch analysis and optimization, to deliver best in class features that achieve set KPI goals 
  • Lead engagement and monetisation for major feature releases, coordinating across disciplines to ensure smooth, high-impact launches which hit KPI targets.
  • Monitor the health of the product ecosystem, using insights to proactively identify opportunities and risks, and implement impactful features and initiatives
  • Identify and create process improvements to support feature development 
  • Build a high-performing team, mentoring product managers and operational staff, scaling team capabilities, and fostering a culture of ownership and excellence.
  • Establish institutional knowledge through clear documentation of experiments, retrospectives, and playbooks to ensure consistent learning and improvement.
  • Conduct quantitative analyses of data to provide key insights into product performance and uncover opportunities for further engagement and monetization
  • Leverage player feedback and game data to inform roadmap and feature design solutions. Use competitive market research to identify future opportunities and feature best practices
  • Manage and develop a team of talented Product Managers 

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous work experience with free-to-play games
  • Strong leadership skills.
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical ability with attention to detail.
  • Understanding of game design concepts and principles.
  • Experience hitting revenue/metric targets on a live game.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for figuring out how game economies work.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • An MBA or a Degree in Economics, Business, Statistics, Data Analytics, or Finance is a plus.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/. 

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: Broker Development Manager
description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! THE ROLE Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission. WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel. A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING: Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success. Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets. Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential. Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance. Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business. Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives. Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin. WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK: ESSENTIAL A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry. Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives. An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm. Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes. Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs. Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business. PREFERABLE Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market. Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers. WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary) 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 Share Incentive Plan 📈 Workplace Pension 💰 Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options) Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵 Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣 £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓 £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻 We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. ONE LAST THING.. Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want! Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
