title: Senior Account Manager
description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

 

👐 About the team

Our Account Manager team key role is to position Alma as a true business partner with our top merchants. In short, our Account Managers are in charge of a portfolio of large accounts, with whom you'll work closely to make them successful.

You'll be arriving at the beginning of the experience, as our team was created in March 2021. There is still a lot to create! This means you'll have a key role in shaping the function.

Reporting to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will work closely with the Sales team, the Onboarding team, the Retail Training team and the Merchant Support team.

This position is a permanent role, based in Paris. 

 

💼 About the job

In a nutshell, your key responsibilities will consist in:

  • Manage, negotiate and retain a portfolio of large accounts. Establish trustful relationships with Alma’s large merchants. Be the key point of communication for the merchants' stakeholders, while working closely with the other functions (Onboarding, Training, Support).
  • Deliver meaningful insights. Analyse merchants' performance to provide superior insights on their businesses. Develop expertise in your field to constantly position Alma as a strategic partner, helping the merchants achieve their goals.
  • Identify key business opportunities. Identify up-sell/cross-sell opportunities on your accounts and develop strategic plans with the merchants. Ensure your accounts get the most out of Alma (maximise conversion, increase turnover, increase basket size) by leveraging the tools we have developed.
  • Be the voice of merchants. Share insights and feedback from merchants with the Product & Engineering team and the wider organisation, helping to constantly improve our solution and the merchants' experience.

 

🧰 You will work with

  • Salesforce
  • Gong
  • Aircall
  • Dust
  • SalesNavigator

 

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have ideally more than 5 years of relevant experiences (full-time permanent positions) in similar functions such as a Sales or an Account Manager / Shop manager in the Retail industry.
  • We are seeking individuals who demonstrate coachability and a strong willingness to learn and grow.
  • You’re fluent in French and a full professional proficiency in English are mandatory. 
  • Commercial skills: You like finding new opportunities for mutual gains. You are at ease in negotiation & closing discussions.
  • KPI Driven: You are comfortable and autonomous in managing your portfolio using identified key KPIs, you like talking numbers!

And it will be nice if you also

  • Demanding and reliable: You set high goals for yourself. You don't compromise on the quality of your work, and you always deliver on your commitments.
  • Empathetic: You easily get into other people's shoes. You are always keen to do the extra mile for clients to make them successful.
  • Autonomous and driven: You know how to find the solution to an issue and look for the information you need. You are comfortable obtaining information from the Alma teams who can help you obtain solutions quickly (product, finance, risk, sales etc...)
  • Great communicator: You have excellent written and oral communication skills. You know how to adapt to your audience.

 

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

 

🧘 What's in it for you?

  • Join a growing company that's reshaping how merchants and consumers connect
  • High ownership from day one, with real impact on business growth
  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas and results matter
  • The chance to help build a category and be part of something meaningful

 

🤑 Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year ****(+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer


🎯 Interview Process

  • Recruiter interview (30 min)
  • Remote Hiring Manager interview (45 min)
  • On-site/Remote Business Case Study presentation (60 min)
  • On-site Final interview with the VP Sales (45 min) + Team Fit (45 min)
  • Reference check

 

🌍 Interview Process

title: Responsable du restaurant ("Club Manager") - Soho House Paris H/F
description:
En tant que Club manager, vous êtes un ambassadeur de la marque et possédez une connaissance approfondie du groupe Soho House et de son concept, y compris l’ensemble des menus et de l’offre de restauration. Faisant preuve d’un professionnalisme irréprochable envers nos managers, nos collaborateurs et nos clients, vous êtes chargé(e) de la gestion quotidienne du Club, de l’organisation des événements qui y sont associés, ainsi que de l’expérience des membres et de leurs invités. Vous veiller au quotidien à ce que l’ensemble de l’équipe du Club fasse preuve d’une attitude positive, en accord avec les valeurs de Soho House Paris.

 Missions principales et responsabilités

  • Superviser les activités afférentes à la Restauration précisément du Club, du Bar et du Cabaret
  • Recruter, encadrer, développer et former le personnel de la Restauration
  • Être un leader inspirant pour l’équipe, la House et savoir résoudre les éventuelles difficultés rencontrées
  • Connaître le budget alloué au département et plus généralement à la House, gérer le revenu des espaces de ventes restauration du Soho House Paris
  • Optimiser les revenus du département restauration et faire des propositions pour augmenter les revenus des points de vente en fonction des évènements de la House, des évènements sur Paris et des saisons
  • S’assurer de la bonne continuité des opérations des espaces de restauration (revenus, personnel, membres, etc.) et favoriser un climat de coopération et de respect dans ces espaces
  • Être en charge de la coordination entre tous les départements et plus particulièrement entre le Club, le Bar et les Evènements
  • Superviser et faire le suivi des approvisionnements, des commandes, des stocks et des inventaires en vue de respecter le budget alloué et les « costs »
  • Être en mesure d’expliquer les ventes, les chiffres d’affaires et les écarts stocks-inventaires pour les rapports financiers hebdomadaires et mensuels
  • Veiller à atteindre les objectifs financiers alloués aux espaces restauration, à les dépasser et être capable d’apporter des solutions en cas de retards financiers
  • Connaître les différents coûts et dépenses des espaces de restauration pour faire le suivi avec le département Financier et la Direction
  • Elaborer conjointement avec la Direction du Soho House Paris et la Direction Financière le budget du département restauration
  • Calculer et connaître les besoins en cours et futurs en termes d’équipements, ustensiles et linges, superviser les commandes
  • Être en charge des projets des espaces restauration, du suivi et de l’avancé des projets (concepts éphémères, soirées exceptionnelles, animations saisonnières, etc.)
  • Superviser la relation des équipes de la restauration avec les membres en veillant à ce que les commentaires, les avis et feedbacks soient pris en compte en vue d’assurer une offre de service satisfaisante pour la clientèle
  • Faire part à sa hiérarchie des retours de la clientèle et des équipes, proposer des améliorations, des solutions en fonction des points mentionnés

description:
Senior Platform Engineer 

À propos du rôle et de l'équipe

La Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) est une Business Unit de près de 200 personnes qui continue de se renforcer pour accompagner les ambitions tech de Decathlon. Notre objectif principal est de rationaliser le catalogue de produits techniques et de fournir des services clé en main pour les équipes IT, afin de leur permettre de se concentrer sur le développement de fonctionnalités à fort impact applicatif.

Au sein de la CPE, tu rejoindras l'équipe Cloud Dev. Notre mission est de fournir des fonctionnalités essentielles et abstraites pour le Cloud, en appliquant les meilleures pratiques de développement d'ingénierie logicielle pour unifier, sécuriser et optimiser nos plateformes.

Tu rejoindras une équipe à taille humaine, composée d'ingénieurs passionnés. Nous sommes fans de développement logiciel, d'Infrastructure as Code, de culture DevOps/SRE, d'automatisation, de veille technologique... et bien sûr, de sport !

Périmètre et missions d'un Platform Engineer

En tant que Platform Engineer, tu joueras un rôle central dans l'autonomisation des équipes de développement grâce à l'ingénierie de plateforme. Tes missions s'articuleront autour des piliers suivants :

1. Ingénierie Logicielle & Abstraction Cloud

  • Utiliser les meilleures pratiques de développement (Software Engineering, Software Architecture) pour concevoir du code propre, robuste et maintenable créant des couches d'abstraction au-dessus du Cloud.
  • Développer et industrialiser des API, outils internes et modules d'infrastructure en Python et Go.
  • Consommer et orchestrer des services Serverless (Google Cloud Functions, Google Workflows) et moderniser l'outillage de déploiement.

2. Infrastructure as Code & Automatisation DevSecOps

  • Concevoir, tester et déployer l'infrastructure de manière cohérente et automatisée avec Terraform.
  • Construire et optimiser des pipelines CI/CD modernes (de préférence avec GitHub Actions) intégrant les standards de sécurité DevSecOps dès la conception.
  • Automatiser les tâches récurrentes par du scripting (Python, Bash) afin de réduire l'effort manuel et maximiser la fiabilité.

3. Intégration Transversale & Excellence Opérationnelle

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Réseau, Sécurité et Bases de données pour garantir des intégrations fluides, performantes et sécurisées.
  • Rôle de Run Captain: prendre en charge le support de niveau 2/3, l'analyse des incidents et le traitement des demandes de service pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle.
  • Contribuer à la définition et au respect des SLO/SLI ainsi qu'à la démarche de réduction du MTTR en automatisant la résolution des problèmes récurrents.

4. Accompagnement, Partage & Culture Produit

  • Rédiger une documentation technique propre et des guides utilisateurs pour faciliter l'adoption des services de plateforme.
  • Sensibiliser et former les équipes techniques aux bonnes pratiques d'utilisation des composants développés.
  • Participer à l'animation collective via la gestion agile de nos livrables dans JIRA et promouvoir le partage de connaissances au sein de l'équipe.

Ce dont tu auras besoin pour réussir

  • Expérience & Dév : Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement Python avec une solide maîtrise des pratiques modernes de génie logiciel.
  • Expertise Cloud : Fortes compétences et expérience avérée sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD : Maîtrise de Terraform et très bonne pratique des pipelines CI/CD (idéalement GitHub Actions).
  • Scripting & Serverless : Bonne connaissance de l'automatisation (Python, Bash) et de l'architecture Serverless / événementielle.
  • Soft Skills & Esprit d'équipe : Excellent relationnel, fort sens de la satisfaction client/utilisateur interne, rigueur dans la documentation et aisance pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.
  • Langues : Anglais maîtrisé à l'oral comme à l'écrit, niveau B2 minimum.
  • Un plus apprécié : Connaissance pour le langage Go, l'utilisation de Google Workflows ou une certification GCP (Associate Cloud Engineer ou Professional Cloud Developer).

Ce que nous offrons

  • Package de rémunération : Package attractif incluant la participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise ainsi que des bonus mensuels, trimestriels et annuels.

Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Notre équipe Data Governance recherche un·e Data Governance Project Manager basé·e à Lille 

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. 

Notre mission : rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client Notre défi ? La rendre gouvernée, sûre et accessible à tous. 

Tu rejoindras le Data Governance Center of Excellence pour transformer nos politiques théoriques en réalités opérationnelles. Ta mission est double : Améliorer les dispositifs de contrôles de la données et garantir la conformité de nos actifs via un framework d’audit robuste. 

TA MISSION : ORGANISER LA STRATEGIE D'AUDIT ET DE CONTRÔLE DE NOS STANDARDS DE GOUVERNANCE

1. Stratégie d’Audit & Compliance

Ton rôle est de mesurer la conformité de l'organisation à nos standards de gouvernance sur l’intégralité de notre scope. 

  • Framework de Contrôle vs Audit : Définir la ligne de démarcation entre le contrôle continu (opérationnel/automatique) et l'audit périodique (stratégique/qualitatif).
  • Industrialisation : Identifier les contrôles éligibles à l’automatisation (ex: intégrité référentielle, fraîcheur via les Data Contracts) et piloter leur mise en œuvre avec les équipes Data Engineering.
  • Audit des "Invisibles" : Concevoir les protocoles(y compris plan d’audit, cartographie des risques et déclenchement de mission ad hoc) d'audit pour les critères non-automatisables (pertinence du dictionnaire de données, qualité des descriptions, respect des processus de classification Privacy), identifier les root cause, les risques et les responsabilités.
  • Gestion des non conformités : Définir la stratégie de suivi des écarts. Tu ne te contentes pas de pointer les problèmes, tu bâtis le framework qui aide les équipes à corriger le tir (scoring, plans d'actions, escalade).

2. Structuration

Tu jouera pleinement ton rôle dans la définition et dans l’amélioration continue de l’operating modèle des audits et des contrôles

  • Mandat : Faire valider le niveau de sponsor et de validation du mandat général et/ou des fiches de mission pour assurer le bon niveau d’engagement des audités. Les décisions devront s’articuler autour du cadre général d’Audit interne de Decathlon
  • Reporting : Communiquer les résultats des travaux et assurer le suivi de la mise en oeuvre des recommandations et, le cas échéant, du processus d’escalade

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expertise en Gouvernance & Data Architecture : Tu maîtrises les frameworks de référence (DAMA/DMBOK), tu comprends les enjeux des architectures modernes (architecture médaillon, Data Contracts, Data Product) et les formats de structuration de données (YAML/JSON)
  • Culture de l'Audit & de la Conformité : Tu as une solide expérience dans la définition de standards, de normes et de protocoles d'audit. Tu sais distinguer un contrôle opérationnel d'un audit de gouvernance et tu es capable de transformer un constat d'écart en un plan de remédiation pragmatique (KRI/KPI)
  • Leadership d'Influence & Change : Tu es à l’aise dans l'animation de communautés (Data Stewards, Producers). Tu sais vulgariser des sujets complexes, lever les points de friction entre technique et business, et porter une vision de "Gouvernance by design"

description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. IMT Mines Albi, au travers du Centre Génie Industriel (CGI), développe des recherches à la frontière entre l’intelligence artificielle et le génie industriel, en collaboration avec des partenaires publics et industriels nationaux et internationaux. Le Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) ( https://cgi.imt-mines-albi.fr/ ) compte environ 70 personnes dont 25 doctorants. Le centre s’intéresse à l’accompagnement de la transition des écosystèmes en permettant de prendre des décisions responsables et durables, dans des environnements instables ou perturbés. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés. Le CGI est structuré selon des axes de recherche appliquée et des programmes scientifiques. Les axes de recherche appliquée sont : Axe FLOWS : Flexible Logistics and Operations for sustainable WorldS dans lequel ce poste est rattaché . Axe DiSCS : Digital Systems for Crisis management and Security ; Axe TRACE : Territorial Resilience, Agility, and Circular Economy ; Axe WHOPS : Well-being and Health through Organizational Processes and Services . Les deux programmes scientifiques au cœur de ces axes de recherche sont : HOPOPOP : Hybridization for Operations & Planning, Organizations & Performance, Optimization & Problem-solving ; AIME-DM : Automated Information Modeling and Extraction for Decision-Makers . DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Dans le contexte de l’Education 4.0, les différents acteurs d’un établissement de formation universitaire (étudiants, personnels, intervenants extérieurs, etc.) ont des contraintes et des objectifs différents ce qui rend complexe la coordination et le pilotage de tels établissements (organisation et planification des enseignements, gestion des espaces collectifs, organisation des sessions d’examens…). En complément, ces établissements doivent s’adapter tant sur la gestion de leurs sites (meilleure adéquation à de nouvelles formes pédagogiques) que sur les flux de personnes les utilisant pour une meilleure répartition des charges et une interopérabilité de tous les outils à disposition (par exemple, un gestionnaire d’emploi du temps). Dans ce cadre, le jumeau numérique organisationnel représente le système qui permet une simulation et une aide à la prise de décision par des échanges bidirectionnels entre l’organisation physique (personnes et systèmes dont les bâtiments) et sa réplique virtuelle dans un objectif de pilotage global des flux. Le projet DIGIFAC’Santé s’inscrit dans ce contexte. Il porte sur la conception et le développement d'un jumeau numérique des sites d’une université, de la gestion des flux étudiants et personnels et de l’évolution pédagogique de ses formations. Un jumeau numérique ne peut remplir son rôle qu'à la condition de représenter fidèlement les informations essentielles à la prise de décision, elles-mêmes issues de données collectées dans les différents services de l’Université et des applications logicielles actuelles. Or, ces applications présentent des niveaux d’hétérogénéité différents selon leurs fonctionnalités. La nature des opérations réalisées (emploi du temps, gestion des salles et du matériel, etc.) impose des contraintes fortes sur la disponibilité de ces données : leur collecte automatique et en temps réel n'est pas toujours techniquement envisageable, ce qui constitue un défi central pour l'alimentation du jumeau numérique. L’étude à mener dans le cadre de ce projet vise à : Modéliser le besoin informationnel . Il s'agit de concevoir un méta-modèle capable de représenter, de façon générique et formelle, les informations strictement nécessaires à l’alimentation du jumeau numérique universitaire. Ce méta-modèle doit permettre de cadrer la remontée d'information en définissant le juste besoin, c'est-à-dire en distinguant ce qui relève de l'information décisionnelle de ce qui constitue un artefact de collecte sans valeur ajoutée pour le pilotage. Alimenter les modèles . Une fois le méta-modèle du besoin informationnel établi, la question de son instanciation à partir de données réelles des applications existantes se pose. Comment alimenter ces modèles à partir de données hétérogènes, partielles, et produites selon des rythmes et des modalités de collecte variables ? Ceci articule des enjeux d'intégration, de qualité et de cohérence de la donnée au regard des exigences du jumeau numérique. Gérer l'absence de certaines données . Dans un contexte où certaines opérations ne permettent pas une collecte automatique et en temps réel, en raison de la nature même des processus mis en place (par exemple, construction de l’emploi du temps, suivi des cohortes d’étudiants), comment maintenir la cohérence et la complétude de la représentation portée par le jumeau numérique ? Ce lot interroge la capacité du système à pallier les lacunes de la remontée de données par des mécanismes d'inférence ou de déduction, permettant de reconstituer un état vraisemblable du système à partir d'informations partielles. Proposer des aides au dimensionnement et au pilotage des sites universitaires . Il s’agit ici d’utiliser le jumeau numérique dans toutes ses fonctionnalités afin entres autres de s’assurer que les évolutions bâtimentaires envisagées permettent d’accueillir l’ensemble des flux actuel et projeté pour cet établissement, de permettre d’optimiser les flux entre les différents sites et de valider les choix d’évolution des pratiques pédagogiques et leur adéquation vis à vis des capacités disponibles (salles et équipements spécifiques, surfaces, personnels,etc.). Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : Modélisation des processus / d’organisation Analyse systémique Analyse de données Ingénierie dirigée par les modèles Aide à la décision Simulation à évènements discrets et jumeau numérique Fouille de processus ( process mining ), Des connaissances en algorithmique, UML, Web sémantique seront très appréciées Capacités et aptitudes : Anglais écrit et parlé (Niveau B2 minimum exigé) ; cf. référentiel européen ; ex. : 785/990 minimum au TOEIC), attesté par une certification reconnue (TOEFL, TOEIC, IELTS). La maîtrise du français (C1 minimum) est exigée afin de faciliter les échanges avec les experts et les acteurs. Capacité à travailler dans une équipe de recherche, autonomie, esprit d’initiative, organisation, curiosité intellectuelle… Motivation pour contribuer à une application universitaire PROFIL RECHERCHE : Ingénieur.e recherche ou post-doctorant, en génie industriel et/ou supply chain management et/ou Génie Logiciel ou Master ou équivalent (niveau Bac+5). AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? : cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha 49 jours de congés par an restauration administrative sur place aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles) INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES : Le poste est basé à IMT Mines Albi, Centre Génie Industriel, Albi (France). Des déplacements sont à prévoir sur le site du partenaire du projet à Toulouse (Haute Garonne), France. Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
 
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do

You will report to the VP & GM EU West and work closely with colleagues across departments and countries, including Finance, as well as external partners and service providers, to help a growing international business run effectively. Your primary purpose will be to provide senior executive and personal support to the VP & GM EU West and to manage the day-to-day operations of our Paris-region office. You will manage a complex calendar, international travel and correspondence in English and French, oversee office operations and suppliers, and coordinate cross-functional activities supporting business growth and upcoming commercial launches. This role requires sound judgment, absolute discretion and effective collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized professional who enjoys taking ownership, anticipating needs and working in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

title: Senior Revenue Ops
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership. You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team , whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost. Why is this role interesting? High-impact scope : You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers. Real ownership : You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery. Builder's playground : You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale. Tangible results : Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate. What will you do with us? You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works. You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks. ⭐ Is it you we're looking for? You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you: Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness , several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure); Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives; Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on; Are confident with change management , including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating; Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them. Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did. Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact Have excellent verbal and written communication skills; Have at least an advanced level in English . Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range . Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport . Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. #LI-DNP Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Senior Associate - Materials
description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

Strategy Associate, Materials & Circular Economy

Location: London preferred. Amsterdam also possible

Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to join our Materials & Circular Economy team. This role is suited to someone who combines strong strategic thinking with the intellectual curiosity to tackle complex sustainability challenges.

You will work on some of the most important questions facing companies, governments and wider society as they shift towards more circular and sustainable models. Projects can range from shaping corporate strategy and identifying new business opportunities to assessing value chains, developing policy recommendations and designing system-level interventions.

We are looking for someone who can bring the core toolkit and pace of a strong strategy consultant: structured problem-solving, analytical rigour, clear communication and sound judgement. Strategy consulting experience is one route to demonstrating this. We are equally interested in candidates from other demanding analytical environments who can show the same quality of thinking and ability to turn complexity into clear recommendations.

You will join small, senior-led project teams and take meaningful responsibility from the outset. You will structure problems, conduct analysis, develop insights and work directly with clients to translate those insights into practical strategic choices.

Responsibilities

You will:

  • Structure complex problems: break ambiguous questions into clear workstreams, hypotheses and analytical priorities.

  • Generate insights: conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis, drawing conclusions from incomplete or complex information.

  • Shape recommendations: translate analysis into clear, concise and practical strategic recommendations.

  • Develop client materials: produce high-quality presentations, briefings and other client-ready outputs.

  • Engage with clients: work directly with senior stakeholders across businesses, governments, foundations and non-governmental organisations.

  • Contribute to project direction: help shape project approaches, hypotheses and emerging strategic conclusions.

  • Build trusted relationships: work effectively with clients, partners and stakeholders across multi-organisation initiatives.

About the team

You will be part of Systemiq's Materials & Circular Economy platform, led by Partner Ben Dixon.

Ben works across circular economy and energy topics and has advised organisations including the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, the United Nations International Resource Panel and multinational companies across packaging, chemicals and related sectors. He also leads Systemiq's work on plastics, focused on accelerating the transition towards a more circular and resource-efficient plastics system.

What we are looking for

Strategy and analytical capability

We are looking for candidates who already demonstrate, or can quickly operate with, the core toolkit expected in strategy consulting. You should be able to:

  • Structure complex and ambiguous problems into clear components, hypotheses and analytical questions.

  • Apply strong analytical judgement to qualitative and quantitative information.

  • Synthesize complex material into concise insights and decision-relevant recommendations.

  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including through high-quality presentation materials.

  • Work effectively at pace, managing changing priorities and imperfect information.

  • Move comfortably between detailed analysis and the broader strategic question.

Experience and background

You will typically bring:

  • At least two years of experience in strategy consulting, advisory or another analytically demanding environment.

  • Evidence of strong performance and increasing responsibility in your previous roles.

  • Experience contributing to strategy, investment, commercial or other decision-focused work.

  • Strong academic achievement, typically including a Master's degree or equivalent experience.

We particularly welcome candidates from strategy consulting, but relevant experience could also come from corporate strategy, investing, high-growth businesses, specialist advisory firms or other project-based environments where structured thinking and analytical rigour are central to the role.

Sector interest and understanding

You do not need to be a specialist across every part of the Materials & Circular Economy agenda. You should, however, bring:

  • An understanding of, or demonstrated ability to learn, complex industrial and consumer value chains.

  • Exposure to sectors such as plastics, petrochemicals, chemicals, consumer goods, manufacturing, mobility, energy or waste management.

  • A strong interest in sustainability, circular economy and the economic and strategic questions involved in system change.

Location

London is the preferred location for this role. We would also consider Amsterdam for candidates whose experience and capabilities are an especially strong match for the position.

Diversity & Inclusion
At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.

title: Senior Director, Health & Safety Operations Europe
description:
About the role 

Reporting to the SVP, Global Engineering and Infrastructure, the Senior Director of Health & Safety Operations Europe serves as a strategic leader driving safety excellence across our European operations. You will champion the development and implementation of robust H&S strategies, ensuring full regulatory compliance while fostering a world-class safety culture. This role demands a visionary leader capable of influencing cross-functional teams and implementing industry-best practices to minimize risk and achieve ambitious safety performance goals.

What you’ll do

  • Define and execute the European H&S strategy, aligning safety milestones with broader business objectives.
  • Cultivate a "Zero Incident" organizational culture by architecting risk-reduction programs across all operations.
  • Safeguard the business by ensuring rigorous compliance with local and international safety regulations and certifications.
  • Standardize safety processes across diverse sites using our newly developed, proprietary safety framework.
  • Partner with Supply Chain and Site Operations leadership to integrate safety into the heart of production practices.
  • Leverage data to track KPIs, providing senior leadership with actionable insights and performance reports.
  • Lead high-stakes incident investigations, ensuring deep root-cause analysis and the execution of effective corrective actions.
  • Act as the primary representative for safety matters with regulatory bodies and external stakeholders across Europe.
  • Orchestrate internal and external safety audits to ensure consistent best-practice standards across all regions.
  • Mentor and develop a high-performing team of safety experts, fostering professional growth and succession planning.
  • Pioneer the use of AI and emerging technologies as accelerators for continuous improvement and safety innovation.

What you’ll bring

  • 15+ years of safety management experience, with at least 5 years in a high-impact leadership role.
  • Subject matter expertise in European safety regulations, multi-national frameworks, and compliance standards.
  • Industry background in FMCG, Logistics, Manufacturing, or Fulfillment preferred.
  • Proven track record of implementing scalable safety strategies across complex, international geographies.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate safety data into strategic business decisions.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders at all levels.
  • A relentless passion for safety and a dedication to continuous operational improvement.
  • Strong leadership presence with a focus on empowering teams and maximizing individual potential.

What we offer 

  • Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
  • Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
  • Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
  • Benefit from long-term wealth creation: Your compensation is heavily weighted toward equity, directly aligning your personal success with the company's future through our Virtual Stock Option (VSO) and Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) plans.
  • Thrive in a high-performance environment: Work with ambitious, intellectually curious peers on a global scale, enjoying an environment built for empowerment and speed.

description:
Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation for Benelux  & Nordics (m/f/d)

Position Summary

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to VP of Global GTM .We are seeking an elite, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across top-tier accounts. Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world’s most mission-critical ERP environments.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. 

 

The SAP "Triple Threat": 

  1. Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles.
  2. SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects  to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations.
  3. GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations.

C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity).

Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base.

Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP’s rigorous reporting standards.

Required Skills/Experience

  • Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner).
  • Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
  • Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees.
  • Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP’s regional field teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO.
  • Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.
  • Language: Professional fluency in English. Additional regional language skills are a strong plus (written and spoken).

Our offer:

  • You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, and an attractive salary.
  • You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.
  • Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.
  • The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.
  • Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.

 

About Onapsis

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world’s leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

Help people find their next home with absolute certainty.

Design isn't here to polish screens. It's here to shape the product. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Listing & Finding experience. You will define what discovering a home feels like: fast, relevant, trustworthy, and human.

title: Projectontwikkelaar
description: Ben jij een projectontwikkelaar met een passie voor vastgoed en gebiedsontwikkeling? Heb je al de nodige vlieguren gemaakt met complexe projecten en voel je je thuis in samenwerkingen met diverse partijen? Wil je zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken aan uitdagende projecten, van haalbaarheid tot realisatie? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Dit wordt jouw baan Als projectontwikkelaar leid je vastgoedprojecten van concept tot realisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, verkoop en het volledige procesmanagement. Van haalbaarheidsstudies tot de start van de bouw: jij houdt het overzicht. Je onderhoudt relaties met partners, beleggers, woningcorporaties en overheden en zorgt voor een vlotte samenwerking tussen alle betrokkenen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die bij gebiedsontwikkelingen bijdraagt aan het realiseren van impact op jouw (deel)project. Dankzij je ervaring met complexe projecten (appartementen en binnenstedelijke ontwikkelingen) weet je snel te schakelen tussen belanghebbenden en bewaak je het totaalplaatje, inclusief conceptontwikkeling, duurzaamheid, budget en planning. Wat ga je doen? Markt & Klant: Analyseren van de marktvraag en het ontwikkelen van passende product-marktcombinaties. Opstellen van grond- en vastgoedexploitaties en coördineren van verkooptrajecten. Onderhouden en uitbouwen van relaties met beleggers en woningcorporaties. Locatie & RO: Begeleiden van RO-procedures en vergunningstrajecten. Organisatie: Coördineren van het ontwikkelings- en ontwerpproces, inclusief de financiële en commerciële aspecten. Tijd & Geld: Opstellen en bewaken van exploitaties en planningen, uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en voeren van onderhandelingen om de beste resultaten te behalen. Jij hebt als geen ander gevoel voor het sluiten van goede deals. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Focus op vastgoed bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer heeft grote ambities als ontwikkelaar. In onze portefeuille vind je uitdagende (gebieds)ontwikkelingen met onderscheidende concepten, veelal op binnenstedelijke locaties. Ons werkgebied beslaat Zuid-Holland, waar we de stedelijke uitdagingen omarmen en maximale waarde willen toevoegen in onze plannen. Dit resulteert in projecten waar je echt impact kunt maken op gebieden als stedenbouw, architectuur, duurzaamheid en sociale cohesie. Als organisatie groeien we naar een vestiging waar jaarlijks 800 woningen risicodragend worden geacquireerd en verkocht. Dit betekent dat we zelf het risico dragen van de aankoop tot verkoop van de woningen. Jij speelt een belangrijke rol in onze complexe ontwikkelingen. Dura Vermeer onderscheidt zich op het gebied van samenwerking. We werken nauw samen met gemeentes, partners en stakeholders binnen onze projecten, en zeker ook met onze collega’s in Rotterdam. We staan bekend om onze intensieve en oprechte samenwerking, die leidt tot innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen in elk project. Op nationaal niveau heeft Dura Vermeer een sterke vastgoedorganisatie waar je op kunt terugvallen. Regelmatig ontmoet je collega’s van andere vestigingen om kennis uit te wisselen en expertise te ontwikkelen. Met onze interne gebiedsstudio, ID, bieden we een expertisecentrum voor ruimtelijke ontwikkeling, marktadvies en verkoopmanagement, acquisitie en gebiedsontwikkeling, dat je ondersteunt bij jouw projectopgaven. Met recent gewonnen tenders zoals Sportcampus Rotterdam , WijCK Pijnacker en De Werf in Oegstgeest en de aankoop van het Hunter Douglas terrein in Rotterdam laten we zien dat we meedraaien op het hoogste niveau van gebiedsontwikkeling. Hier zit je op je plek Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het ontwikkelen van gebieden en buurten en het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen. Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige teams, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams. description: 31-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,– stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master | 6-12 maanden Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot De energietransitie is in volle gang. Overheden en bedrijven werken toe naar het behalen van Europese en landelijke doelstellingen, maar dit is vaak makkelijker gezegd dan gedaan. Om beleid tot uitvoering te brengen, moeten uiteenlopende belangen, overtuigingen en visies bijeenkomen. De grenzen tussen beleid en uitvoering zijn daarbij soms vaag. Op dat snijvlak werken wij: wat is de beste strategie om de doelen te behalen, en hoe werken we daar samen naartoe? Daar heb je kennis van de energietransitie voor nodig, maar ook gevoel voor mensen, context en organisaties. Dit is uitdagend, complex en leuk! Wil jij meewerken aan de meest urgente energie- en klimaatvraagstukken van Nederland? Wil jij met frisse ideeën en nieuwe inzichten bijdragen aan oplossingen voor uiteenlopende organisaties? En ben je benieuwd naar het werk bij een adviesbureau? Berenschot biedt jou de kans om tijdens een stage actief mee te werken aan deze complexe en actuele uitdagingen! De startdatum van je stage is 1 oktober 2026 (in overleg). Dit ga je doen Als stagiair(e) werk je onder andere mee aan opdrachten die gaan over energiesystemen, netcongestie, de warmtetransitie, betaalbaarheid en systeemweerbaarheid, op landelijk, regionaal én lokaal niveau. Opdrachtgevers zijn overheden (ministeries, provincies, gemeenten), netbeheerders, energiebedrijven, uitvoeringsorganisaties en woningbouwcorporaties. Daarbij werken we niet alleen voor, maar vooral ook mét onze opdrachtgevers. Een aantal voorbeelden van opdrachten waaraan wij werk(t)en: Het uitdenken en opbouwen van grote nationale uitvoeringsprogramma’s van het Klimaatakkoord, zoals het Nationaal Programma RES, het Nationaal Programma Lokale Warmtetransitie, het Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem, en programma’s rondom hernieuwbare opwek (zon op dak, wind op land, etc.). Het begeleiden van (grote) gemeenten bij het ontwikkelen van een warmte(net)strategie. Het ondersteunen van netbeheerders en provincies bij de ontwikkeling en programmering van het energiesysteem van de toekomst (Energievisies) en het verminderen van netcongestie. Overheden helpen met het opstellen van effectief klimaatbeleid met behulp van prognoses op basis van onze eigen Regionale CO2-routekaart. Het uitvoeren van volumeprojecties voor waterstofdragers richting 2035, om inzicht te krijgen in de verschillende stromen en knelpunten. Het ontwikkelen van een alternatief nettariefstelsel voor netbeheerders, waarmee de netbelasting wordt gespreid en netcongestie wordt beperkt. Overheden helpen met het opstellen en uitvoeren van beleid en plannen om de energietransitie rechtvaardiger te maken (bijvoorbeeld door bestrijding van energiearmoede, de inzet van fix-teams, het sturen op isolatie, etc.) Tijdens jouw stage krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan adviesopdrachten en lever je een bijdrage aan interne projecten, zoals bijvoorbeeld evenementen. Je werkt als stagiair(e) écht mee aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten!” Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. title: Senior Controls Engineer
description: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen. Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Wat bieden wij jou? Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME) Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk Vakantiegeld 8% CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00 Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities Wat ga je doen: Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley. Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel) Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen. Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem. Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000 Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA) Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal) In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken? Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst. We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt. Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent. Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken. 👉 Is deze functie perfect voor jou? Neem dan voor meer informatie contact op met Jan Peter Westland van bureau Staal Verbind ( De werving en selectie voor deze vacature wordt verzorgd door bureau Staal Verbind.
