title: Senior Manager, Enablement Learning Experience
description: Reports to: VP, Sales Enablement About Axiom Axiom, a leading global marketplace for on-demand legal talent, is leading a revolution in the legal industry. The Axiom model disrupts the traditional allocation of work to law firms and in-house teams. By matching highly credentialed lawyers and legal talent with legal work across industries and practice areas, Axiom enables clients to become more agile and efficient and empowers lawyers and legal talent to pursue more of the work they love. Axiom serves over half the Fortune 100 with market leading NPS ratings from both its clients and employees. Role Summary The Senior Manager, Enablement Learning Experience is a key member of the Sales Enablement organization responsible for turning business needs, subject-matter expertise, and enablement strategy into high-impact learning experiences. This is not a traditional instructional design role. We are looking for an experienced enablement professional who is also an exceptional builder—someone who understands sales, knows how adults learn, and can translate complex ideas into simple, engaging experiences that help sellers and leaders perform differently. This person will serve as a shared learning-experience resource across Enablement, partnering with Global Programs, Field Readiness, and other members of the team to architect and build scalable learning solutions. The role will have particular responsibility for expanding our self-paced and digital learning capabilities while also contributing to live workshops, blended learning journeys, presentations, video, and performance-support resources. The right person is equally comfortable meeting with a senior subject-matter expert, defining learning objectives, developing a learning architecture, building an e-learning experience, editing video, or creating a polished executive-quality PowerPoint deck. What You’ll Do Build High-Impact Learning Experiences Design and develop engaging self-paced learning experiences that translate complex concepts into practical, actionable learning. Build digital learning using tools such as Articulate 360, Storyline, Rise, or comparable authoring platforms. Create and edit video, audio, graphics, presentations, and other multimedia components to support modern learning experiences. Develop highly polished PowerPoint presentations and facilitator materials for live and virtual enablement. Build supporting resources including job aids, practice activities, assessments, reinforcement, and point-of-need performance support. Ensure learning experiences are practical, engaging, concise, and grounded in the realities of the sales environment. Architect Learning Journeys Partner with Enablement leaders to translate business priorities into effective learning strategies and experiences. Define clear learning and behavioral objectives tied to the outcomes a program is intended to achieve. Help architect blended learning journeys incorporating self-paced learning, live workshops, practice, application, reinforcement, manager involvement, and performance support. Recommend the right learning modality based on the audience, desired behavior change, business need, and complexity of the content. Apply adult-learning and learning-experience-design principles without over-engineering solutions. Partner with Subject-Matter Experts Work directly with subject-matter experts across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Legal, and other functions to extract expertise and translate it into compelling learning. Lead structured working sessions with SMEs to identify what learners truly need to know and do. Simplify complex or highly technical material without losing its substance. Provide thoughtful recommendations and challenge content when necessary to keep learning focused on the intended audience and business outcome. Build credibility with senior stakeholders and independently manage the content-development process from discovery through delivery. Serve as a Shared Enablement Resource Partner closely with Global Programs, Field Readiness, and other Enablement functions to bring programs and initiatives to life. Provide learning-experience expertise across multiple concurrent enablement initiatives. Establish repeatable templates, standards, and approaches that improve the quality and consistency of Enablement deliverables. Help the broader Enablement team determine when to build, reuse, adapt, or simplify learning solutions. Create scalable assets that can be adapted across segments, audiences, and programs. Leverage Enablement & Learning Technology Build, publish, manage, and maintain learning experiences within Seismic and other learning and enablement platforms. Leverage LMS functionality to organize curricula and learning journeys, manage assignments, and track completion and engagement. Help establish scalable standards for digital learning development, publishing, maintenance, and governance. Evaluate emerging learning technologies and capabilities and identify practical opportunities to improve the learner experience and increase development efficiency. Manage the Work Manage multiple projects simultaneously across different programs, stakeholders, and deadlines. Establish clear development plans, milestones, dependencies, and review cycles. Balance speed and quality, recognizing when an asset requires significant production and when a simpler solution will achieve the desired outcome. Maintain and update learning assets as programs, messaging, processes, and business priorities evolve. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or a closely related enablement function. Demonstrated experience personally building enablement programs and learning experiences—not simply managing external vendors or instructional designers. Strong hands-on expertise with digital learning authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Storyline, Rise, or equivalent. Experience creating and editing video and multimedia learning content. Advanced PowerPoint skills and a strong eye for information design, visual storytelling, and presentation quality. Experience working with learning management systems and sales enablement platforms; Seismic experience is highly desirable. Strong understanding of adult learning, learning-experience design, curriculum development, and blended-learning principles. Demonstrated ability to establish clear learning objectives and translate them into practical learning experiences and assessments. Experience working directly with subject-matter experts and senior stakeholders to develop content. Strong understanding of sales environments and the needs of sellers and sales leaders. Excellent written communication, editing, and content-simplification skills. Strong project-management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and not every process or tool has already been established. Highly collaborative, resourceful, detail-oriented, and willing to personally build. Preferred Experience Experience supporting complex, consultative, services, or B2B sales organizations. Experience with Seismic Learning or comparable enablement and learning platforms. Experience building curricula for multiple sales roles, segments, or stages of the seller journey. Experience creating scenario-based learning, simulations, practice experiences, and assessments. Experience helping establish or scale digital-learning capabilities within an enablement organization. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means becoming the person the Enablement organization turns to when an important idea needs to become an exceptional learning experience. You will take expertise that may initially exist in a subject-matter expert’s head, a PowerPoint deck, a process document, or a business strategy and turn it into something sellers and leaders can understand, practice, and use. You won’t simply build what you’re handed. You’ll ask what people need to do differently , determine the best way to help them get there, and then build an experience that makes that happen. Your work will allow the broader Enablement organization to move faster, scale further, and deliver consistently high-quality learning experiences across the business. Axiom’s total rewards philosophy is to be transparent and equitable with all job candidates. The salary range for this Senior Manager-level U.S.-based remote role is $168,000–$204,000 OTE. You can also participate in our benefits programs, which include healthcare, life and disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, paid sick and personal time off, paid parental leave, and more. Please note that final compensation is determined by several considerations, including the quality of your experience and expertise, your ability to immediately contribute to Axiom, your potential to progress to the next level, the market in which you are located, and other business considerations. Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will attempt to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in the application process. To request an accommodation to complete the application form, please contact us at benefits@axiomlaw.com and include “Applicant Accommodation” in the subject line. #LI-NS2

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description: Overview of the role: We are launching a new Home & Auto insurance business unit, and you will build the revenue engine that supports it from the ground up. As Revenue Operations Manager, you will own the 0-to-1 design and implementation of the CRM, sales processes, reporting, and operating workflows that help this business acquire and serve customers at scale. This is a hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys creating structure where little exists. You will shape how leads enter the funnel, how opportunities move through the sales process, how teams manage customer handoffs, and how leaders understand performance. You will administer and evolve HubSpot, connect it with the tools our teams rely on, and establish the data foundation for a new line of business. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to translate an emerging business model into practical systems and repeatable processes. From defining the first pipeline stages and routing rules to launching dashboards and improving workflows, you will help create the operating backbone for Home & Auto while building scalable standards for the broader revenue organization. You will be both a systems owner and a business partner: identifying what the business needs next, designing pragmatic solutions, and making sure each process is adopted, measured, and improved over time. What you’ll do: Own our revenue systems and data Administer and continuously improve HubSpot, including objects, properties, pipelines, workflows, automation, permissions, validation, and reporting Maintain a scalable CRM architecture, including naming conventions, property design, object associations, required fields, lifecycle stages, and deduplication Manage user access, team permissions, provisioning, and system governance Monitor system health, investigate issues, and coordinate fixes with vendors and technical partners Improve processes across the customer lifecycle Design and optimize lead routing, pipeline stages, handoffs, lifecycle definitions, and data governance Build workflows and automations that reduce manual work, improve consistency, and help teams move faster Manage integrations and data flows between HubSpot, Five9, Front, and other business systems Identify friction across the customer journey and translate it into clear, scalable process improvements Turn data into better decisions Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into pipeline, conversion, retention, productivity, and customer activity Support forecasting, planning, territory analysis, segmentation, capacity planning, and compensation analysis Partner with functional leaders to define metrics, establish reliable reporting, and improve confidence in the data Surface trends, risks, and opportunities—not just numbers—and help stakeholders act on them Deliver change that sticks Gather requirements, evaluate options, and recommend solutions that balance business impact with operational effort Plan, test, document, and launch system changes with clear communication and change-management support Monitor results after launch and iterate based on user feedback, adoption, and business outcomes Create process documentation, system guides, and training materials that make the right way easy to follow Build trusted relationships across teams and deliver improvements with and through stakeholders What we’re looking for: 5+ years of experience in revenue operations, CRM administration, business systems, sales operations, or a related field Strong, hands-on experience administering HubSpot CRM in a complex or growing organization Experience designing CRM workflows, automation, integrations, permissions, reporting, and data-governance practices Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across systems, data, and business processes Experience gathering requirements, testing changes, managing releases, and documenting technical processes Strong spreadsheet and reporting skills, with the ability to turn messy data into clear insights A practical, solutions-oriented mindset and a bias toward action Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences A collaborative approach and the ability to influence across teams without relying on formal authority Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality Nice to have Knowledge of, or experience working in, the insurance industry Experience supporting Five9, Front, Confluence, and Jira HubSpot Administrator certification or equivalent practical experience Familiarity with SQL, data modeling, APIs, webhooks, JSON, or workflow automation Experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or a similar business-intelligence platform Experience with CRM release management, integration monitoring, or business-systems support Why join us: Generous PTO - 20 vacation days A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!) Access to stock options based on performance Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $110,000 to $150,000 CAD , based on experience. We'll walk through the details together during the interview. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: About Axiom : As the leading alternative legal services provider globally, Axiom gives in-house legal teams on-demand access to top legal talent and lawyers — deployed when, where, and how clients need it, for up to 50% less than national law firms. Axiom's network of 14,000+ legal professionals includes 4,000+ lawyers with Fortune 500 experience, delivering AI-enabled legal services across more than 12 practice areas. Trusted by 75% of the Fortune 100 and thousands of mid-market leaders, Axiom ranks #1 among Alternative Legal Service Providers in 8 of 9 performance categories — including talent quality, breadth, productivity, and client experience — according to a top 5 global consulting firm. Across more than 3,000 engagements annually in 6 regions and 4 continents, 93% of clients rate Axiom lawyers as good as or better than top law firm attorneys, with 96% client satisfaction and measurable cost savings that reduce outside counsel spend without sacrificing quality. Stop overpaying for law firm work. Start with Axiom. About the Team: We exist to inject new energy and new thinking into a precedent-bound profession. We love the company we’re building with undignified enthusiasm. We’re committed to our mission and to our people. We celebrate our successes, learn from our failures, and find opportunity in adversity. We surround ourselves with inspiring, talented people who have a contagious energy and incurable passion for what they do. We pride ourselves on listening and relating to our colleagues and clients in a way that’s genuine, human, and memorable. We care about the little things. Our People: Generate new, creative, and disruptive ideas to change the status quo in their fields Possess an unbelievable work ethic and unwavering commitment to quality Stretch beyond what’s expected and prioritize ongoing learning and development Assume best intentions and take a ‘glass half full’ approach to their work Bring others together, creating strong relationships across lines of difference Seek to understand and learn from perspectives counter to their own Leave a lasting impression About the Role: We are looking to hire salespeople to fuel our continued growth across verticals (Technology, Financial Services, Consumer Services, Life Sciences, and Industrials/Energy Tech). With our backing and proven success, we’re looking for evangelists – salespeople who can envision a better future for clients, bring clients to see that vision, and create lasting partnerships that exceed clients’ greatest expectations. This role is well-suited for a highly consultative seller who’s accustomed to sitting at the table with executive-level decision makers to devise solutions to their toughest problems. You will be afforded a high degree of accountability and ownership over a portfolio of F500 and industry leading clients focusing on account growth as well as new business generation. Specifically, you will spend your days: Originating opportunity and closing deals: You will be responsible for bringing in new business (new logo generation), originating and selling to our biggest fans, and making believers of fresh clients. Getting to know your clients: You will define the client experience by building durable relationships, inspiring trust, and proposing innovative solutions to their problems. Consulting with C-level executives: Our clients are savvy leaders of the world’s largest in-house legal teams, and you will be at the table with them daily planning for their future. Collaborating: At Axiom we pride ourselves on our cross-functional sales culture. This is a not a role for the lone wolf seller. You will partner daily with the broader commercial team to close and support strategic opportunities. Leading: You will offer thought leadership to clients as well as internally mentor and offer professional insights to junior team members. About You: You have a background in B2B client service and have extensive experience consultative sales role where you exceeded business goals on a monthly, quarterly, and/or annual basis. You have a proven track record in heavy business development initiatives and generating new logos. You are comfortable working in a senior role as an individual contributor. You understand what goes into the sales process from prospecting to close, and you’re no stranger to managing multiple complex deals across multiple clients and stages. You are highly organized with a meticulous attention to detail and pattern recognition, you manage your time well and possess expert judgment and decision-making skills. You are a high-impact communicator and know how to present to executive-level stakeholders. You’re no stranger to PowerPoint and the rest of Microsoft Office Suite. You know your way around Salesforce (or comparable CRM system) and understand the importance of leveraging data to make smart decisions about where to spend your time. You demonstrate a relentless service orientation, effortlessly form trusted-advisor relationships, are catalytic in your desire to improve the status quo, and can operate effectively within a highly collaborative team environment. You are legally eligible to work in the United States. Axiom’s total rewards philosophy is to be transparent and equitable with all job candidates. The annual base salary range for this role located in Chicago, Illinois is $80,000-$130,00 depending on experience. You will also be eligible to participate in our Quarterly Bonus Plan which on target would be 65% of your base salary for a Manager or Senior Manager level role in our Commercial business unit. You can also participate in our benefits programs that include healthcare, life and disability coverage, 401K with company match, paid sick and personal time off, paid parental leave and more . Please note that the final compensation is determined by several considerations, including the quality of your experience and expertise, your ability to immediately contribute to Axiom, your potential to move up to the next level, the market you are located in, and other business considerations.
